row.name: Zeppelin Rush
row.detailed_description: Zeppelin Rush is a reverse tower defense game where you lead a crew of furious goblins in an explosive assault aerial assault against a heavily fortified dwarf stronghold. The dwarves stole your gold, now it’s payback time. Build and pilot a fleet of goblin-engineered war zeppelins, smashing through enemy towers while collecting loot to upgrade your fleet and multiply your forces. Choose your path across lanes of combat, with varying tower layouts and rewards. Adapt your strategy mid-flight by upgrading engines, armor, and weapons as you make your way further into enemy territory! Each run is a fast-paced mix of strategy, destruction, and resource management, challenging you to balance risk and reward on the fly. With chaotic goblin tech, real-time destruction, explosive visuals, and strategic lane selection, Zeppelin Rush delivers an action-packed twist on the tower defense formula from the sky, with vengeance. Take flight. Break towers. Reclaim your gold. The goblins are coming - and nothing is safe... Fast paced gameplay requiring rapid decision making Intense layout of enemy towers that foster intense combat Economy based deployment and upgrade system
row.short_description: A Tower Offense game in which you deploy goblin manned zeppelins in an effort to earn money and destroy the dwarven fortress.

row.name: Pieceful Gallery
row.detailed_description: In real life, there are many jigsaw enthusiasts who, for various reasons, can’t complete a puzzle. Pieceful Gallery is a game that fully simulates the classic jigsaw experience: use your mouse to organize and rotate puzzle pieces, then assemble the entire image in the traditional way. There’s no space limitation, progress is saved automatically, and levels range from easy to difficult. Come try it for free! Game Features: · Faithfully replicates the operation and challenge of a classic jigsaw—easy to learn and use · Each level features a high-definition work of art, allowing you to appreciate masterpieces as you play · Puzzle sizes increase from 100 to 1,000 pieces, suitable for beginners or seasoned players of any age · Relaxing background music to soothe your mind while you play (All art used in the game is in the public domain.)
row.short_description: A classic jigsaw game—each puzzle is a stunning work of art, replicating the operation and difficulty of traditional jigsaws. Come experience Cyber Puzzle now~!

row.name: Don't Get Your Hopes Up
row.detailed_description: Don't Get Your Hopes Up is a short interactive comic about housing shortage and horror in architecture.  Based on desperate apartment searches undertaken in 2022 and 2024, and drawing from a half decade of conversations about Amsterdam's housing crisis, the game moves between fiction, documentary, and social commentary. With disquiet and creeping unease, it dismantles the consoling fictions of abundance, and laments a feeling of home that's always just beyond reach. Short, emotional, and relatable (unless you're a landlord)  Playtime: 40-60 minutes. Dive into a week of apartment hunting through the eyes of Krish and Yan, a couple looking to find an apartment in Amsterdam. Classic visual novel gameplay meets sparse, parallax comic book illustrations, with a few narrative and mechanical twists.  View odd apartments and make tough decisions on renting and overbidding. Experience a moving story about precarity, solidarity, alienation, and the systems that keep us apart. A haunting post-punk soundscape  Immerse yourself in a haunting, propulsive soundscape featuring music by Simon Frank and a special track by Rotterdam band Neighbours Burning Neighbours.  A uniquely Amsterdam story that is resonant everywhere 'EVERYTHING HAS TO CHANGE, FOR ANYTHING TO STAY THE SAME.' Learn a wayward history of contemporary Amsterdam that is resonant globally. Play through a carefully constructed bricolage of references, ideas, speculations, and social commentary about the housing crisis that attempts to distill fleeting perceptions of an ambient present into coherent yet unsettling images. 'State-of-the-art maleficence”, with inspirations from Leila Taylor’s Sick Houses , Joshua Comaroff and Ker-Shing Ong’s Horror in Architecture , and Ayşegül Savaş’ The Anthropologists .
row.short_description: You're looking for a new apartment in Amsterdam. Your once-confident search is morphing into panic. Nothing is available. Anything will do. ANYTHING.
row.reviews: “Don't Get Your Hopes Up is a good game because not only is it good commentary on the (many, worldwide) housing crisis (especially how those intersect with racism and the climate crisis), it also understands that yes, I probably would rent a flat that contained an exact replica of itself in dollhouse form, complete with a little doll me, and inside that replica another replica of another flat, another future, spiralling in on itself forever. Housing market's in shambles isn't it.” regicidal-defenestration, Tumblr “A deeply engaging, vital, eye-opening piece of work, chock-full of empathy and critical thinking.” 4/5 – So Many Games “I had a hard time finding a single sentence in this thing I didn't want to screenshot...do dig in.” Rock Paper Shotgun

row.name: The Night Is Long
row.detailed_description: The Night Is Long is a short first-person Lovecraftian inspired horror game that explores grief, guilt, and the chilling unknown. In the midst of emotional turmoil, a grieving man sets out on a nighttime drive, desperate to escape the pain of his past. But when his deceased wife suddenly appears in the middle of the road, he swerves into the unknown — and follows her into a long-abandoned mansion. Inside, reality begins to unravel. The deeper he explores, the clearer it becomes: the night is long, and he is not alone. Use your wits and determination to survive the horrors within and uncover the truth buried in the shadows of the mansion. Features An emotional, story-rich experience Exploration-focused gameplay with storytelling delivered through scattered notes and hand-drawn illustrations A chilling atmosphere that builds psychological tension Random paranormal events to keep you constantly on edge A sanity system that dynamically affects ambient and sounds Classic key-hunting and inventory puzzles Mindful, well-placed jump scares that enhance atmosphere and tension
row.short_description: The Night Is Long is a short first-person horror game where a grieving man follows a ghostly vision into an abandoned mansion. Uncover dark secrets, survive atmospheric horrors, and face your past through exploration, puzzles, and subtle scares.

row.name: Ani Idle
row.detailed_description: Ani Idle is a Fantasy RPG with an Idle-like playstyle. Jump into a short adventure and try to kill all the enemies and clear all the dungeons. While not fighting, you might feel like taking a rest, do some quests or craft your gear to make it more powerful. Your Character: You will have different stats like attributes (used for quests), regeneration, crit chance, chance for DoTs or just raw damage. Damage types include physical, fire, ice and lightning - the same goes for your resistances. Find the best combinations to fight your enemies, because they have the same kind of stats. Classes: Depending on your weapon you will have one of five classes and each class has their own skill you can use in combat. Fight: Start with some low-level slimes, like every good adventurer does. Soon you will kill more dangerous enemies and loot their gear to make it yours. Kill enough of them to also level up and become stronger and stronger. Dungeons: When you are ready, start exploring dungeons, that will contain several enemies in a row. This is the only place, where you cannot flee, so be prepared! Quests: Good adventurers will have to do some quests from time to time. Explore weird places, help some people (or not) and gather some loot here as well. Each quest will let you choose between three options and sometimes they just have random outcomes and could also depend on your attributes. Rest: You deserve it! Inventory: Sort and check your precious loot. Equip your gear or see what kind of delicious consumables you might find. Crafting: If you have already found some crafting crystals, this is your place to be! Use them to reroll your gear, try to make it the best you currently need. Achievements: Of course there are Achievements to collect and hunt! Some might be easy, but others might need some more research. Check the menu for some advice on how to get them. Ani Idle is the very first game I developed. It started as a hobby and grew into something special. I am proud to have made it this far and hope you will like my little Idle-like RPG adventure game as much as I do.
row.short_description: Ani Idle is an Idle-like RPG in which you will have to fight a variety of enemies. Kill them, collect their loot, take a rest, do some quests and craft your gear to become more and more powerful.

row.name: Tawa : Lost in Time
row.detailed_description: About the Game – Tawa: Lost in Time Tawa: Lost in Time is a narrative survival-adventure game where players step into the fragile paws of Tawa, a small mouse lost in a vast and unforgiving prehistoric world. After being separated from her family by a powerful earthquake, Tawa finds herself alone in an ancient land dominated by dinosaurs and primeval landscapes. To survive, she must navigate a hostile ecosystem where she is not a predator — but prey. Designed as an immersive single-player experience, the game blends emotional storytelling, stealth-based gameplay, and environmental puzzles into a cinematic journey. With no dialogue or traditional HUD, the story is told entirely through animation, music, and environmental cues. Key Features Immersive prehistoric world Explore five unique biomes — coastal beaches, dense forests, volcanic cliffs, mysterious ruins, and an isolated central island. Each zone features unique visual identity, dynamic soundscapes, and carefully designed danger zones populated by ancient creatures. Stealth and survival mechanics Avoid predators, stay hidden in tall grass, burrow under roots, or freeze to avoid detection. Timing and observation are crucial. Tawa cannot fight, but she can outsmart, escape, and endure. Narrative-driven exploration Experience a silent story of resilience, fear, and hope. Tawa’s journey is a visual and auditory tale shaped by her surroundings and her reactions to them. Naturalistic gameplay systems Tawa’s stamina, health, and perception are influenced by environmental conditions. Rain, heat, hunger, and exhaustion all affect how she moves and reacts. Players must read the world like an animal would. Dynamic audio and visual cues No minimaps or UI distractions. Distant rumbles, predator calls, rustling bushes, and changing light conditions serve as navigational and survival signals. An emotional journey with thematic depth At its core, Tawa: Lost in Time is about vulnerability, family, and finding one's way in a world that is indifferent to your existence. It's a poetic and existential experience rooted in naturalism and quiet intensity. Who Is This Game For? Tawa: Lost in Time appeals to fans of atmospheric, story-rich indie games and nature-based adventures. Players who enjoy titles such as Ori and the Blind Forest , Stray , INSIDE , Shelter , or Spirit of the North will find familiar themes of survival, environmental storytelling, and emotional resonance. The game is particularly suitable for: Players looking for non-violent, thoughtful gameplay Nature lovers and fans of prehistoric themes Fans of cinematic platformers and immersive audio-visual design Gamers interested in indie storytelling and symbolic worldbuilding Technical Details Platform: PC (with console versions planned) Engine: Unity Genre: Adventure, Survival, Narrative Mode: Single-player Language: Universally understandable through visuals and sound (no spoken dialogue) Development status: Early access demo available soon

row.name: Nelli The Seer
row.detailed_description: A STUDENT VIDEO GAME PROJECT Nelli The Seer is a game developed by first-year students at a video game school. The team had 14 weeks to deliver a third-person action-adventure game set in a historical temple. Game Design and Level Design students started pre-production first, followed three weeks later by the Environment Artists, Animators, and Character Riggers. The programmers joined the project seven weeks after the Game Designers. Game Design and Level Design students had seven weeks of pre-production, while the Environment Artists, Character Rigger and Animator teams had four. Then, all teams worked together during the final seven weeks of production to complete the game. The result is a platformer blended with a memory-based puzzle game , offering about 30 minutes of gameplay . NELLI, A FORMER AZTEC WARRIOR TURNED PRIEST At the beginning of the 16th century , you play as Nelli , a young man from Tenochtitlan. Once a proud Aztec warrior, Nelli is granted the gift of foresight by Tezcatlipoca , the god of night and destiny. Upon discovering his new ability to see the future, he chooses to become a priest. A DARK PROPHECY In his final vision, Nelli sees a grim fate awaiting his people : soldiers will invade the great city of Tenochtitlan , capital of the Aztec Empire. Determined to warn his people, he seeks an audience with Emperor Moctezuma II . However, the emperor does not believe him, Nelli’s prophecy contradicts those of the high priests. NELLI'S QUEST To prove his vision, Nelli ventures deep into the Templo Mayor . His goal : to reassemble the Obsidian Mirror , a sacred relic of the Aztecs and the divine attribute of Tezcatlipoca . Its fragments are scattered throughout the temple’s hidden chambers. Once the mirror is restored, Nelli hopes to convince the emperor of the truth. CORE GAME MECHANICS • Use Nelli’s athletic abilities : jump , climb , and crouch to reach areas inaccessible to ordinary people. • Activate mystical mechanisms  : open ancient stone doors, move platforms, and create new paths through the temple. • Collect the Feather Gem to gain the ability to glide. This power lets you reach normally unreachable zones and interact with objects while falling. • Harness Nelli’s gift of foresight : lie down on vision altars to extend your view into the future. Reveal hidden spikes, avoid sudden traps, and spot disappearing platforms. Remember trap patterns and safe paths to complete your quest and fulfill your destiny.
row.short_description: Nelli The Seer is a third-person platformer and memory game. Jump, glide and see the future to collect the treasures present in the Templo Mayor. Collect the fragments of the obsidian mirror to show the future to your people.

row.name: Urban Undergrounds
row.detailed_description: Urban Undergrounds Face the darkness. Find your friend. Escape the unknown. You are an experienced urban explorer, known for venturing into abandoned places where no one else dares to go. One day, your best friend Marcus invites you to investigate an old, decaying urban bunker hidden deep in a forest far from civilization. When you arrive, an overwhelming sense of dread overtakes you. A bone-chilling shriek sends both of you running for your lives. But Marcus can’t let it go. Days later, he returns to the bunker alone—and now he’s missing. With no other option, you gather your courage and return to the bunker yourself. The forest falls silent as you step into the cold, concrete depths… and descend into something far worse than you imagined. Gameplay Overview Urban Undergrounds is a first-person indie horror game that combines atmospheric exploration with survival elements. Players must navigate a labyrinth of abandoned hallways, hidden rooms, and locked-off areas, while uncovering the horrifying truth behind the bunker. Key Features Explore the Unknown: Traverse eerie corridors, pitch-black rooms, and decaying underground facilities filled with environmental storytelling. Survive the Dangers: Face off against terrifying threats—some seen, some unseen. Use stealth and caution to survive. There are no weapons ; your only option is to escape or hide. Solve Puzzles and Unlock New Areas: Progression requires collecting keys, finding clues, and solving environmental puzzles to unlock new sections of the complex. Discover the Story: Piece together the mystery of the bunker through notes, visual details, and the disturbing discoveries you encounter. Immersive Horror Experience: Expect sudden jump scares, intense audio design, and psychological horror elements that will keep you on edge. Single-Player Experience: This game is a solo survival experience designed for players who love atmospheric, narrative-driven horror. Content Warning ⚠️ Urban Undergrounds contains rapid flashing lights, sudden jump scares, and intense horror elements. Recommended Age: 16+ Technical Info Gameplay Style: First-person exploration, stealth, survival horror Platform: PC (keyboard & mouse, controller support optional) Estimated Playtime: 1–2 hours (varies by play style) Saving: Auto-save system with checkpoints

row.name: Skaldsong
row.detailed_description: About This Game Gather your friends (or just yourself) and step into a world without a script. Skaldsong is a multiplayer RPG platform that combines the deep mechanics of classic CRPGs with the narrative freedom of tabletop role-playing. Here, the story is not pre-written. It's generated live, guided either by a human Game Master using our toolset, or by an advanced generative AI that acts as your Game Master. There is daily free AI Usage for everyone! Stuck as a forever DM? Lacking friends but want to play a TTRPG? Have friends but nobody wants to be the one to run the game? Just want to see what AI can do? Then this game is for you. A True RPG Engine Skaldsong is not another hastily thrown together AI chatbot. It is a complete game engine with robust, underlying systems that feel like a modern evolution of classic MUDs (Multi-User Dungeons). The AI's role is not to solely run the game, but to create content for it. You are not limited to pure adventure games, using custom Game Rules, you can play all sorts of games- Slice of Life school romance? The management of a mercenary company? Fight in the gladiator pits? Interstellar Empire management? With the right ruleset, the AI can smoothly run about any game you can define. When the AI responds to your actions, its narrative is embedded with special [Tags] . Our custom parser reads these tags and translates them into mechanical changes within the game state. If the AI describes you finding a sword, a [Create_Item] tag mechanically adds that sword to your inventory. This system ensures that the story and the game mechanics are always perfectly in sync. While the interaction is text-based, the world is fully visualized. You are not just reading text; you are interacting with graphical character sheets, inventory windows, a world map, quest logs, and more. I'm tired of hastily put together AI games that look like, frankly, dogwater. Skaldsong is a demonstration of how you can truly use AI not to replace the game, but enhance it. Free-to-Play and Paid Content Skaldsong is free to download and play. The core software, including the multiplayer framework and all non-AI GM tools, is available to everyone at no cost, meaning if you join a friend or public lobby, you will have to pay nothing to play with them.  Additionally, every player gets 40 free actions/generations using our subscription model for free per day. If you want unlimited usage of the subscription model, there is a $15 subscription for 30 days of unlimited usage available for purchase in-game or a higher tier $25 subscription which includes image generation. But to use the premium models and image generation, these all use credits which can be purchased through Steam. Credits are spent as used. The cost of AI features (outside Unlimited usage) depends on factors such as the size of your game world, how many characters are in your game, and various other settings you can tweak to meet your cost threshold. Tips on managing cost and other helpful information can be found on the Skaldsong Discord. The AI as a Creative Partner When you play with the AI GM, you just tell it what genre, setting, and type of game you'd like to play. Guided by those, the AI's responsibilities include: Reactive Storytelling: Generating narrative outcomes, NPC dialogue, and environmental descriptions based on your party's specific actions. On-Demand Content: Creating new characters, items, quests, and locations as the story demands them. AI-Powered Art: Generating images based on your characters and locations. Generally, if a character is wearing something, the image will show it. If you see an object in a scene? You can interact with it. Create character portraits, item icons, and stunning location art on the fly. These assets are then automatically shared with all connected players, bringing your shared world to life visually. You can select from a list of pre-written art styles or create your own. Built-In Text-to-Speech with Custom Voices:  If your computer can handle it, you can use our built-in TTS system to generate voice overs for your game using custom voices. You can use one of the preset ones or add your own! Seamless Multiplayer & Asset Sharing Built on Steamworks, Skaldsong is designed for a hassle-free multiplayer experience. The host controls the world, and clients connect to share in the adventure. Our system automatically synchronizes all necessary game assets, including any AI-generated images or custom music tracks the host chooses to use. When using the AI, only the lobby host needs to have credits. If you're playing as a player, there is absolutely no cost associated with AI usage. A UI That Does Not Make You Puke Designed to work with all your information being in windows you can scale, resize, and reposition. Use one of the pre-built color themes or make your own. Use a custom background or let the game set the background based on the location your party is in. Change to a favored font even. You can even drag 'stickers' of your characters and items onto the screen to place them directly in the location as you play. But the most important thing, is that the UI won't make you want to puke! A Powerful Tool for Human Game Masters The AI is completely optional. Skaldsong can be used as a powerful platform for running your own TTRPG campaigns with friends. As a human GM, you can ignore the AI entirely and use the game's systems to: Track character stats, health, and inventories for all players. Manage a world map with custom locations. Create and assign quests through the built-in quest log. Distribute loot and currency mechanically. Keep a persistent, savable record of your campaign world. Play included or custom music or other .mp3s to all of your players at once Future tools (Battlemap) in the roadmap
row.short_description: A singleplayer/multiplayer RPG reminiscent of TTRPGs mixed with MUD games but with content generated by an AI Game Master.

But with each severing, the original owner of the body will die too. Will our new Cube Ninja, who just took shuriken from his dying master, end everything? Or he’s just another soul that also lost in slaughter, like those ghosts? The ninja needs to resolve this battle as quickly as possible; he must find the origin of all this and then eliminate it. Ninja Moving Fast The ninja's fast movement skills come from the power of shuriken. The ninja first needs to throw the shuriken. After the shuriken is thrown, the ninja can immediately rush to the shuriken. The enemy hit by the shuriken will fall into a flaw, and the ninja's sprint can instantly kill the enemy who falls into the flaw. In addition, the ninja also masters karate. It will automatically kill or block any danger that is close enough. But once the shot is made, the ninja will fall into a flaw. After killing the enemy again, you can attack again. In the level, the goal of the ninja is to kill enough enemies and reach the end. In the level, the ninja does not need to kill all the enemies, but only needs to find the fastest route in the vast sea of enemies. Game highlights: 1. Move at super high speed, passing through the scene like flowing water. 2. Plan the route with enemies as nodes. 3. Use terrain to fight. 4. Interesting mini-game levels. Ninja Eat

row.name: ScreeIN
row.detailed_description: Screeln’s game begins with the end: your death. The rest is a descent into fragmented memories and constructed realities. Using a broken television set as a gateway, you switch channels — each one a surreal stage, echoing a piece of your past. ScreeIn blends exploration, environmental puzzles, and narrative horror into an episodic structure. Each “channel” is a level designed around a specific trauma, a specific rule, a specific lie. Some are quiet. Some are violent. All are watching you. As you navigate haunted offices, infinite parking lots, looping corridors, and abandoned domestic spaces, your role shifts. Sometimes you’re a solver. Sometimes you’re the observed. Sometimes you're no longer sure. In every space, you must enter the screen to proceed. Throughout, strange rules govern each space — rituals you must obey, or break, or decipher. These rules aren’t always written, and breaking them may not mean what you think. To move forward, you must solve puzzles rooted in these shifting logics. Scattered across these scenes are physical traces of progress — things to be remembered or reclaimed. You collect channel buttons as keys to advance, each one anchoring you to a deeper truth. The game uses a reverse narrative structure: the further you go, the closer you come to your beginning. In time, you may exit the screen, discover what truly led to your end — or get lost in the noise trying.
row.short_description: ScreeIn is a psychological horror experience about isolation, memory, and self-deception — a fragmented journey into a mind on the edge.

row.name: Accordion Solitaire
row.detailed_description: A different kind of solitaire. Accordion Solitaire is a more difficult, more strategic variation of solitaire. Starting with a shuffled deck, you will draw cards and make decisions about how to stack them based on matching ranks and suits. But there are strict rules about when cards can be stacked: When a stack is adjacent to a matching rank or suit. When a stack is separated from a matching rank or suit by exactly two other stacks. The goal of the game is to begin with one deck of cards, and end up with one stack of cards. It will be trickier than you might think! Features Multiple Rulesets Accordion Solitaire features 3 rulesets that change the way the game is played: Strict Draw one card at a time, and all possible moves must be made before drawing again. Relaxed Draw one card at a time, but you can continue to draw without making all possible moves if you choose. Free Draw the entire deck at once and play with full knowledge. Accessibility Accordion Solitaire comes with some accessibility features that make it possible for all to play. Possible move hints When holding a stack, possible moves will be highlighted to make it easier to understand your options.  Defaults to On. Auto draw Automatically draw cards until there is a possible move (only applicable when using Strict or Relaxed rules) so you don't have to click the deck manually as often.  Defaults to On. Reduced motion By default stacks shake when they have possible moves to make it easier to understand your options. If the shaking is distracting or overwhelming, you can force all stacks to stay still. Defaults to Off. High contrast Places a color filter over each suit to make it easier to understand when stacks have matching suits. Defaults to Off. Music & Sound Fully adjustable Music and Sound sliders allow you to modify volume in-game. Music and Sound can also be enabled or disabled. Defaults to enable Music and Sound, with volume set to 50%. Tutorial If the above rule explanation is difficult to wrap your head around, don't worry! There's a full tutorial in-game that will explain the concepts of Accordion Solitaire very clearly. The tutorial uses the following features: Strict ruleset Show possible move hints Auto draw The tutorial takes possible move hints even further by dimming stacks which would be impossible to move your held stack onto. The tutorial will equip you with everything you need to know in order to be successful at Accordion Solitaire!

row.name: This Winter of Ours

This Winter of Ours  is a fantasy/yuri visual novel that tells the story of two girls surviving in a hostile winter forest, and living their new life together day by day.  As day turns to night and the last of the grass is suffocated by snow, apprentice merchant Delia finds herself completely lost and alone. With no hope for survival, she finally lays to rest her dreams of learning magic and discovering the secrets of her world, allowing herself to be taken by the elements. Yet she awakens, and finds an unfamiliar figure lying next to her. A girl who is similarly yet uniquely alone. While she isn't forthcoming on any details of herself, the girl agrees to escort the merchant to safety, thus beginning their presumably short-lived adventure. Little do the two know, they both have what the other needs. Will they be able to find that hidden treasure within each other, or will doubts and secrets consume them both? An apprentice merchant traveling in her father's shadow. Cordial yet anxious, she struggles to fit in with the life of a trader, secretly yearning for her dead dream of studying magic and becoming a mage. If only she had a little push. A short-spoken survivalist who calls the snowy forest her home. Initially a nameless stranger, she is given the name 'Lux' when she encounters an estranged merchant in training. Despite her distrustful nature, something within her compels her to help the apprentice trader escape the forest. Resource Management - Balance your money, public reputation, and processing power as you click your way into fully automated clicking and purchasing systems. Multiple Endings - Your choices ultimately determine whether humanity and AI find harmony, or something else entirely. Unique, hand-drawn art - All in-game art is hand-drawn and includes over 50 unique game icons and clicker art made by TheAverageGoob ​! The Vibe Shop is full of items to change your clicker once you become a Vibe Lord. Click responsibly. The AI is watching.
row.short_description: An idle clicker where you evolve from college graduate to Vibe Lord. Click, automate with AI tools, manage resources, and discover multiple endings in this satirical take on modern work life.

row.name: Silent Residence
row.detailed_description: A Schizophrenic's Story Play as Harry, a man tormented by schizophrenia and multiple personalities. Delusions and hallucinations twist his world and perspective, turning friends and neighbors into threats. Harry’s mind can’t decide whether it wants help or total control.  Silent Residence is a psychological horror game about mental tension , identity , fear , and losing touch with reality . You must push on and fight your isolation with what's real. You can't give up. A Psychological Horror Experience A place taken in your apartment complex. The little details and your surrounding environment will feel the same, but they always have a frightening aspect to them.  NPC Interaction Interact with your neighbors and friends to narrate the story further. The people you live with can't be trusted. They always feel like a stranger to you, no matter how long you've known them. Hallucinations & Delusions The surrounding environments twist and change to simulate the horrors of schizophrenia. You never feel comfortable in one space. Keep moving and fight your delusions. You are nobody's isolation.
row.short_description: Experience Harry's story of battling multiple personalities and his severe case of schizophrenia. In this First-person horror game, you battle the hallucinations and illusions your mind creates. You misjudge reality and quickly lose control over yourself.
row.notes: This game contains scenes with visible blood, corpses, suicide, and violence that may be disturbing to some players. Especially those sensitive to mental health and graphic imagery.

row.name: Guns&Sodas
row.detailed_description: INFO GUNS&SODAS is a fast-paced arcade rogue-action game where explosive sodas and relentless gunfire mix into a high-octane experience! In a world where the Five Primal Sodas , the base ingredients of every drink ever made, have been stolen, only you, the Chosen Can Hero, can bring them back. Get ready to face waves of armed enemies, dynamic environments, and unleash the full power of the legendary Vending Machines ! THE 5 PRIMORDIAL DRINKS Collect the Primordial Drinks to unlock permanent effects for future runs. KEY FEATURES • Stylish, high-speed arcade action: Dash, shoot, and chain combos in a fast and fluid combat system. • Rogue-lite mechanics: Start each run from scratch, but as your skills improve, you’ll earn higher scores to unlock better gear and alternate paths . • Super Dash: Dodge enemy fire with high-speed acrobatic moves using the side mouse buttons (or by quickly pressing the left and right mouse buttons in sequence), or by pressing L3 on the gamepad. • Vending Machines as allies: Activate and upgrade VMs to gain rear cover. Some drop powerful gadgets that trigger your Super Shot . • Tons of guns: Discover a wild arsenal of pistols, each with its own unique mechanics and playstyle. • Combo system: Chain kills to boost efficiency and increase your final score.
row.short_description: GUNS&SODAS is a fast-paced rogue-action arcade where legendary sodas, wild guns, and explosive combos collide. Recover the Primal Sodas and unleash chaos with the power of Vending Machines!

row.name: Summoners War: RUSH
row.detailed_description: KEY GAME FEATURES Summoners War: Rush is an idle tower defense RPG where you build a team of Monsters to battle. Feast your eyes on fascinating Monster artwork and stunning skill effects, and take on stages and Defense mode bosses with your ever-evolving Monster lineup! Log in now and claim 14 essential top-tier Monsters and all the materials you need to start growing them—for free! Stages Climb through stages and face off against increasingly strong bosses. The higher the difficulty, the better the rewards. Exploit each boss's weakness to clear stages faster and reach new heights! Sky Island Defense (Tower Defense Mode) Enter Sky Island Defense, a unique tower defense mode. Strategically place your Monsters and unleash skill cards to wipe out waves of incoming enemies. Coordinate support skills to take down powerful bosses. Don't miss limited-time campaign events tied to new Monster releases—packed with valuable rewards. Magic Orb Use Magic Orbs to instantly acquire equipment. If a newly obtained piece is stronger than what's equipped, it will auto-replace to boost your power. Equipment is collected even during battle, making your progression both dynamic and satisfying. Challenge Put your skill card usage and Monster placement to the test in Challenge Mode! Face 25 intense waves on massive tower defense maps—twice the size of Sky Island Defense. Make real-time card choices, compete on the leaderboard, and aim for top ranks in new weekly seasons! Land of Conquest Hop aboard your airship and conquer zones across the Land of Conquest. Defeat bosses and capture regions to earn loot—including powerful boss Critters. Guild Dungeon Join forces with your Guild to defeat powerful dungeon bosses. Form a 50-Monster army—25 from your team and 25 from your Guildmates. Work together, rack up points, and fight for the #1 spot in the Guild rankings! Critters Collect Critters that boost your team’s overall stats just by owning them. Each Critter enhances a specific attribute, and their power increases with upgrades and level-ups. Summon Strengthen your Monsters to unlock their full potential. Awaken them to gain unique, powerful skills. Use your upgraded team to push back waves of enemies!
row.short_description: Summoners War: Rush is an idle tower defense RPG where you collect and strengthen your Monsters to build a team and defeat waves of enemies! Fight increasingly powerful foes across Stage Mode and Tower Defense Mode. Build your ultimate team and dominate every challenge!

row.name: 春琉ト怪夜
row.detailed_description: An adventure game where you aim to escape a storied mansion with a mysterious girl named 'Haru' who you meet there. Story The protagonist heads for a mansion in the mountains after receiving a message requesting aid from Yukie, who they've felt indebted to since middle school. There, they are awoken by a girl named 'Haru' at the entrance, then gradually come face-to-face with the terrifying truth behind the mansion... System Features a fully-voiced story and a high sense of freedom/immersion with how you can search rooms in any order you want. Also comes with multiple endings that branch off based on hints you find while searching for a way out of the mansion and choices you make regarding said hints. Characters Haru (VA: Harusaruhi): A woman that waited at the mansion the protagonist wakes up in. Bears somewhat of a resemblance to Yukie. Cheerful and kind, she's uncomfortable with others learning her shortcomings. Toriru (VA: Sakuya Momono): A black cat found in the mansion with Haru. Apparently had an owner, judging by the collar. Protagonist: A college student not good with people, but consequently never forgets a debt to those who treat him kindly. Lives an ordinary life. Controls Left Click/Enter: Next Page. Right Click/Space: Hide window. Ctrl: Skip. AUTO/SAVE buttons: Can use by left clicking the appropriate buttons. row.name: Imperfect Garden
row.detailed_description: Immerse yourself in a world that was once full of life and color, but now holds only remnants of what it used to be. Gardens that once boasted vibrant flowers and singing fountains now lie dry and covered in dust. Temples that were once majestic stand broken and half-entombed by withered vines. The wind sighs through the ruins, carrying a strange silence, as if time itself has stopped. Across this landscape walks a nameless youth. As a child, he lost his right arm in an accident he can no longer recall clearly. Despite the pain of his prosthetic, he carries his sword with unwavering resolve. The sky above him is forever painted in shades of orange and gray, like an endless sunset. Here dwell the Perpetuos, ancient beings wielding a dark power that relentlessly expands the desert. It is said that whenever one of them awakens, the land around them withers a little more. The youth knows that if they are left unchecked, soon nothing living will remain in this place. Your character’s skills are essential for surviving in this hostile world: Attack (Red): Deliver a frontal slash with your sword, engaging enemies head-on. Dash (Blue): Execute a swift forward movement, letting you dodge enemy strikes and reposition strategically. Parry (Yellow): Block and counterattack at the precise moment, using your sword to deflect blows and create openings. Crossbow (Green): Draw a crossbow to strike from afar, temporarily swapping your sword for a ranged weapon. To defeat each boss, you’ll need to blend your skills with cunning and perfect timing. Watch their tells closely: a slight recoil before a sweeping strike, a flicker of light before an energy blast, or a subtle trembling in their limbs—all signal the perfect moment to strike. Good luck, warrior, and may your determination shine beyond the darkness!
row.short_description: Imperfect Garden is an action-packed boss rush with two levels, each culminating in a unique boss that tests your reflexes. You control a one-armed youth in a desolate world, fighting powerful Perpetuos—proving that determination can triumph over adversity.

row.name: God's Continent
row.detailed_description: Travel benefits Gift Pack Redemption Code: godvip666 godvip777 godvip888 How to Redeem: Copy the redemption code - Click the avatar in-game - Redeem the gift pack Join our QQ group, Discord, and community discussion group to receive special gift packs (Japanese) About the Game The meteorite from outer space, like a ray of death light, cut through the vast starry sky and fell heavily to the Kalia continent. The huge impact force generated by its explosion, like a raging tsunami, almost swept the entire continent. This disaster not only brought material destruction, but also awakened the seven ancient demon kings sleeping in the forgotten land. Their awakening broke the balance of the world, and the Kalia continent instantly fell into the abyss of darkness, and a world-destroying catastrophe was about to come. At this moment of life and death, the legendary son of God came to this world with a mission. He will reunite the power of light, courage, and hope, fight a desperate battle with the dark forces, and fight to restore peace to the world. ​ The hero professions in the game are rich and diverse, with 6 major professions: Berserker, Mage, Shooter, Assassin, Shield Warrior, and Sacrifice, each with its own unique characteristics. Berserker, with powerful melee output ability, is like a meat grinder on the battlefield; Mage, who controls the power of elements, can cause high spell damage to the enemy at a long distance; Shooter, with superb archery skills, fast attack speed and high hit rate; Assassin, with quick shots, good at stealth and burst, can give the enemy a fatal blow in an instant; Shield Warrior, is a solid barrier for the team, with strong defense ability and health value to effectively protect teammates; Sacrifice, is the life guarantee of the team, with super strong healing and gain capabilities. ​ Before the battle begins, players can clearly see the enemy's information and position, so as to adjust the position and lineup in a targeted manner. The victory conditions and requirements in different battle scenes are different. Players need to pay attention to the battle prompts, the order of killing the opponent's monsters, and other requirements to achieve a perfect clearance. ​ Hero skill matching is also a highlight. Unlike conventional card mobile games, the hero skills here can be released manually by the player, and heroes with different attributes can stack different skill buffs, which can produce completely different effects. If you get stuck in a battle, you may find the key to a breakthrough by studying the effects of hero skills and releasing them in a reasonable combination. ​​ The hero development system is rich and in-depth. Players can use experience potions to increase hero experience, help heroes improve their ability levels, comprehend new skills and passive characteristics of skills, and use breakthrough gems to unlock new skills when they reach a certain level. In addition, the resources required for each level and rank upgrade and the effects after the upgrade are clearly informed to the players, so that players can accurately estimate the overall improvement and allocate development resources in a targeted manner. ​ Each hero has an independent equipment system and rune system. Different heroes with different runes can change the basic combat attributes of the hero, adding variability to the linear hero development mode. The game uses advanced graphics technology and high-end physics engines to create a colorful magical world. The characters and scenes are beautifully designed, whether it is an ancient European castle, a grassland in the wilderness, a mysterious cave, or a snow-covered mountain, they are all lifelike. The full-process sound effects output and the soft and sweet voice-overs of the beautiful girls bring players an immersive gaming experience. During the battle, the natural and smooth fighting movements and the gorgeous and cool skill effects make people excited.
row.short_description: 'God's Continent' is a strategy card game. You will enter a magical world full of fantasy and adventure. Along the way, you can form a powerful team of your own among the three races of humans, beasts and demons, and embark on the road to fight against darkness.

row.name: The Traded Groom
row.detailed_description: Today's your wedding day, and you've never met your husband. You're the chief of several semi-nomadic clans; he's an imperial prince of the Han people, with whom you have a complicated political relationship. You meet for the first time on the same day you marry, and you quickly find that he isn't the arrogant, prideful prince you'd expected. Get to know him over the night and find out whether he's a spy for your enemies or a victim of political schemes; and most of all, whether this marriage can work. Features: 35k words (1-2 hours of reading) One husband, who may turn into a love interest, friend, or remain a stranger 8 CGs (4 NSFW) 5 endings to the wedding night 4 epilogues and 3 extras after the wedding night, showing how your choices have shaped your relationship
row.short_description: A short adult otome about an arranged marriage and the many forms your new relationship can take.
row.notes: The Traded Groom contains optional NSFW scenes. These scenes are accessed through choices labelled "(18+ scene)".

row.name: Last Stop Horror Hospital
row.detailed_description: Last Stop Horror Hospital - Where Fear is the Ultimate Illusion. Enter a modern hospital originally an asylum shut down for experimental therapies. Escape Mr. Giggles and Investigators who are trying to stop an unknown contagion. One way in and One way out. However, you can roam all about the hospital area. You walked in the Front Door, so Collect his 'Toys' and you walk out the Front Door to ecsape. Mr. Giggles a former mental patient obsessed with evil clowns. He feeds on illusion, traps, puzzles, and torment. Investigators in hazmat suits attack you and are under his influence. Find the resources you need staying one step ahead of attackers while fighting your way out.
row.short_description: First person horror game in which you will need to use strategy and the objects in your enviroment to win, while fighting off Investigators under the control of an evil clown.

row.name: R.A.T.: Human Error – Episode One
row.detailed_description: Please note that there is a f12 bug that restarts the whole game, this will be fixed as soon as possible The war ended in a blinding flash. Now, the earth is hollow, a fractured shell hiding the remnants of humanity. A new era of evolution is about to begin. Survivors fled underground, but salvation was a lie. A sickness spread, warping minds, twisting bodies. No one is being spared. You are a child, taken to a hidden facility deep below the surface. You don’t know why. Only that you’re sick. That everyone is. And something is wrong.You have to escape. Crawl through the vents. Follow the echoes to get to the surface. Your mother is waiting for you. Explore a surreal, underground facility  by clicking through rooms, searching for clues, interacting with objects, and uncovering hidden paths. Converse with strange and varied characters , your choices affect what you learn and who you can trust. Crawl through dark vents to move between areas. The  Rat Maze is  a skill-based mini-game with multiple paths! Choices matter : your decisions shape the narrative, unlock secrets, and determine which of the multiple endings you reach.
row.short_description: The world ended. Now the real nightmare begins. Deep underground, a child wakes in a infected facility. Minds are breaking. Bodies are changing. Crawl through vents, follow echoes, and escape before it’s too late. Your mother is waiting.

row.name: Mar
row.detailed_description: Mar is a first person low quality small horror game where your only task is to escape monster by searching for specific items to escape each location. The game features several maps ranging from underground dungeons and dreamy like place. Your objective is to collect 5 specific items in each place to unlock your way to escape. The monster's task is to hunt you down and prevent you from escaping so make sure that you aren't in its way. Game is designed to give a old-school gameplay style with low quality environment and some camera effects.
row.short_description: Mar is a first person low quality small horror game where your only task is to escape monster by searching for specific items to escape each location.

row.name: 凡人修仙传奇
row.detailed_description: 欢迎加入官方社群 加入官方社群，可联系游戏管理员反馈游戏问题，了解游戏最新动态，还可以参与社群活动。 官方QQ群：1067707950 About the Game ⚔️以修仙为主题，挂机打BOSS的放置类RPG游戏，玩家将扮演一位普通的少年，在机缘巧合下获得神器昊天镜，从而踏入修行之路，凭借神器的强大与过人的毅力和谨慎的智慧，最终逆天改命、修炼成仙！ 🔥【本作特色】 ☯️玩法内容丰富： 拥有闯关升级、打BOSS掉装备、结婚生子、组队打BOSS、PVP竞技等丰富玩法，游戏内容的丰富度丝毫不逊于各类MMO游戏。 ☯️独创的昊天镜系统 昊天镜是本游戏的一大特色系统，通过不断升级昊天镜，可以在闯关击杀BOSS时，获取到更强大的装备。不断提升昊天镜的等级是玩家最核心的最求！ 【游戏玩法】 🗡️主线闯关 随着关卡的解锁，也会同步解锁各类系统与玩法，完成主线任务是所有i玩家前期最大的目标！ 🐉BOSS玩法 大量山海经神话中的异兽将是游戏中玩家们的主要敌人，击杀他们可以各类稀缺的道具。 BOSS分为个人BOSS，多人BOSS，世界BOSS，组队BOSS等，随着玩家等级越高，可以解锁更高级的BOSS 📜仙法 仙法是修仙文化中必不可少的内容，在本作中玩家可以获取到十数种仙法，攻击型、回复型、增益型等，每个仙法各具特色。 玩家最多同时可以佩戴6种仙法，根据自己面对的场景，可以自由搭配，形成个人风格的组合。 ❤️姻缘玩法 法侣财地中的侣，是修仙文化中的四大核心追求，是修士得道成仙的基础。成功缔结仙缘将是修仙路程中的重要一环！拥有仙侣之后，不但可以双修，参加仙侣试炼，获得信物与婚戒，还可以抚育子女，还可让其一同作战，所谓上阵父子兵！ 🏔️ 洞府玩法 法侣财地中的地，是每个玩家到中期必定要发展的目标。经营好自己的洞府，能够让你在修仙的道路上获得较大的助力，拥有洞府就意味着有无穷无尽的资源来支撑修炼仙法 ⚡仙将附体 在游戏后期，可以激活仙将，在短时间内获得碾压一切的能力！是每个玩家的最后的杀手锏！ 🔱仙器与法宝 神兵、仙剑、坐骑、灵宠都是每个修仙之人必备之物。玩家在游戏中通过与异兽的搏杀、前往危机重重的洞天冒险，都有机会获取到。 🏯宗门 一个强大的宗门，将会成为玩家修仙过程中的重要靠山。加入宗门后只要做出相应的贡献，就可享受宗门带来的大量福利。 在这个修真的世界里，资质能让你快人一步，法宝神器能让你比同阶人更强大，但唯有靠超出凡人非同寻常的意志力、敏锐的观察力和一颗不被俗世干扰坚毅的心才能最终蜕凡成仙，成为至高无上的仙尊，这就是凡人修仙的传奇历程!
row.short_description: ⚔️以修仙为主题，挂机打BOSS的Idle RPG游戏，玩家将扮演一位普通的少年，在机缘巧合下获得神器昊天镜，从而踏入修行之路，凭借神器的强大与过人的毅力和谨慎的智慧，最终逆天改命、修炼成仙！

row.name: CanKendama
row.detailed_description: By playing with this VR application, you can learn the techniques of Kendama, a traditional Japanese toy. There are two types of techniques that can be learned: “Moshikame” and “Tsubame-gaeshi”. If you practice these techniques in the app, you will be able to do them in the real world. In the VR world, you practice in an environment where the ball moves slowly and then gradually becomes faster. The system supports smooth progress with fewer stumbles. Please practice Kendama while following the model moves that appear in front of you, and then try actual Kendama in the real world. 【Warning】 This app is only compatible with Quest. Please note that other devices may cause hand orientation or malfunction.
row.short_description: This system enables you to play Kendama in the real world by practicing Kendama in the VR world.

row.name: Curyeux
row.detailed_description: Curyeux is a dreamlike puzzle-platformer where Lucienne Grégoire , the protagonist, embarks on a personal quest for meaning. Journey through fragmented memories drawn from her artistic world, as she dives deep into a period of intense introspection. Each level is a piece of memory, where logic gives way to perception. You’ll need to run, jump, solve, circumvent, and understand in order to move forward… and uncover yourself along the way. The adventure leads you through ever-changing painterly environments  : sketches, watercolors, bursts of color and brushstrokes, where appearances are often deceiving . Lucienne must learn to see through her own illusions, accept who she is, and break free from the gaze of others. Key Features 🎨 A variety of painterly landscapes , where every shape reflects an emotional state. 🧠 Puzzles that challenge your reasoning and perception : observe, understand, and experiment. 🌌 A symbolic and touching narrative , told through the environment, movement, sound, and gameplay. An introspective journey about identity , self-acceptance, and the transformative power of doubt .

row.name: Iron Dusk Path of Honor
row.detailed_description: Iron Dusk: Path of Honor is a gripping 2D/3D hybrid medieval action-adventure where honor is forged through fire, steel, and sacrifice. Step into the boots of a fallen knight as you embark on a cinematic journey across a war-torn kingdom, haunted by betrayal and bound by destiny. Once a celebrated hero, you now fight to reclaim your name in a land overrun by cultist tyrants, ruthless pirates, and shadowy forces. Cast into the depths, forced into arenas, lost at sea, and hunted by ancient evils, your path to redemption winds through arena combat, treacherous towns, and storm-wracked shores. ⚔️ Features Epic Story-Driven Campaign – Follow a fully narrated, chapter-based storyline with dramatic voiceover and cinematic presentation. From dungeons to duels, each act builds toward a climactic final confrontation. Hybrid Visual Style – Traverse a stylized world where 2D art blends seamlessly with 3D combat arenas and environments. Skill-Based Combat – Slash, block, and strike with precision in reactive real-time battles. Right-click for light attacks, left-click for heavy blows, and time your parries to survive deadly encounters. Morality and Choices – Lie, gamble, or fight your way forward. Outwit pirates in games of Liar’s Dice or take your chances with your sword. A World of Danger and Wonder – From outlaw ports to Viking cult villages, the world of Iron Dusk is rich with atmosphere, mystery, and danger. Dynamic Encounters – Face brutal arena fights, bar brawls, sea storms, and siege warfare as you climb from disgrace to glory. 🛡️ Will You Rise? Fight for your kingdom. Reclaim your honor. Face the cult. Confront the king. The dusk is falling—but from the ashes, heroes rise.
row.short_description: A 2D/3D hybrid medieval action-adventure game where you fight, block, and outwit enemies in real-time combat while navigating arenas, pirate towns, and cult strongholds on a quest to reclaim your honor.

row.name: My Sexy Neighbour 2 | Prologue
row.detailed_description: Welcome to the prologue of My Sexy Neighbor 2 — the forbidden origin story where everything begins. Before the fans, before the fame, and before the full-on madness, there was just you — a bored nobody with a camera, a dirty mind, and a thirst for something more. What started as a joke — a few dares, a few sneaky clips — is about to spiral into something wild. 👀 Peep into lives behind closed doors. 🚪 Test your limits with petty break-ins and first risky stunts. 🎥 Discover the thrill of being watched — and paid for it. 💬 Meet the first voices of your future fanbase: hungry, twisted, and very generous. 💦 And yes — expect things to get hot. Very hot. 🎮 What’s in the prologue: 🌃 First missions — low stakes, high tension. 🛠️ Basic tools and dirty tricks. 🔞 Softcore mischief meets hardcore curiosity. 💻 A peek into the dark web future. 🌐 Open world with real-time flow — do what you want, when you want. 🧠 NPCs live their own lives — watch, follow, interfere... or seduce. ⚠️ What happens next? That’s up to you. But this is where it all starts — with one bad decision that feels way too good. Your story’s about to go viral. Ready to hit “record”?
row.short_description: Before the fame came the thrill. In this provocative prologue to My Sexy Neighbor 2, you take your first steps into a world of voyeurism, dares, and dirty cash. Sneak, stream, seduce — and discover how one wild night can change everything.

row.name: Lost in the Woods
row.detailed_description: Violet’s marriage is falling apart. One night, in a desperate attempt to make things right, she ventures into a mysterious forest, determined to gather the cherished belongings that once brought joy to her husband. But the woods are filled with secrets: a strange will-o’-the-wisp appears again and again, its intent unclear - friend or foe? As Nordic folklore comes to life around her, the line between reality and memory begins to blur. A Journey into Darkness On her search for the lost fragments of her relationship, Violet encounters strange objects and enigmatic creatures. Some seem familiar, others frighten with their strangeness. As she ventures deeper into this surreal forest, the line between reality and delusion begins to blur. Things appear that shouldn’t exist, memories twist, and every decision can lead her fate further into an unexpected direction. Explore. Uncover. Remember. Wander through the eerie woods and uncover their hidden secrets. Collect scattered clues like fragments of Violet’s past and interact with mysterious objects that sometimes promise answers… and sometimes only raise new questions. Listen to Violet’s voice as her thoughts, doubts, and longings come to life. Every step and every spoken word brings you closer to the truth… or drives you further into madness. Everything Changes What once felt familiar may vanish in the blink of an eye. New paths open, and known places shift their appearance. The forest lives and transforms with every step you take. Nothing remains the same, and each discovery pulls you further into a labyrinth of secrets that will never let you go. Choices That Matter Your choices shape not only her path, but also the reality around her. Are you ready to lose yourself and uncover every hidden truth? Features A short story told through 2D exploration in a surreal setting Visual novel passages with two possible endings A deep psychological story about love, loss, and madness Unique visual scenes and illustrations Dark atmosphere and subtle horror A journey between reality, memory, and delusion
row.short_description: 'One last try' Violet is determined to save her broken marriage - at any cost!Wandering through a dark forest in search of lost mementos, she finds the world around her shifting with every step.
row.notes: The game addresses psychologically challenging themes such as toxic relationships, mental health issues (including depression), and prescription drug misuse, presented within a narrative context. These elements are depicted as part of a surreal, story-driven experience.

row.name: W|RE
row.detailed_description: Summary W|RE is a short fast-paced, first-person shooter where you play as a veteran hitman—tired of routine contracts—who takes a mind-altering drug that radically changes how he perceives the world. In this altered state, sound becomes light: every gunshot, footstep, or musical beat sends out colorful waves that briefly illuminate the environment in glowing outlines. Your mission is simple: reach the target location and eliminate your enemies as fast and precisely as possible. The faster you are, the more money you earn. If you're not satisfied with your performance, try again—perfect your rhythm, and climb the highscore ladder. Goal The goal is to clear all rooms in a level as quickly and efficiently as possible while maximizing your score. Your final score is affected by several factors, including clear time, headshot count, hits and accuracy. The better you perform, the more your employer is willing to pay - and the higher you climb on the leaderboard. Setting The world of W|RE is inspired by the cyberpunk aesthetic: dark, industrial environments lit by vibrant color and driven by pulsing music. A short comic-style cutscene introduces each run, explaining your mission and setting the tone. Speakers placed throughout the world reinforce the rhythm, making every level feel like a playable beat-driven hallucination where your perception is as much a weapon as your gun.
row.short_description: A veteran hitman, bored with routine assignments, alters their perception with a mind-bending drug, shifting to a stripped-down reality, where they perceive only sounds as light as they eliminate their targets as fast as possible to earn more money.
row.notes: The game displays the use of drugs to change the vision of the player and the use of guns to eliminate enemies, there is no display of blood or injuries as enemies explode into coins

row.name: LIGHT-BRINGER
row.detailed_description: Witness a psychedelic vision of American Christianity. LIGHT-BRINGER is a first-person exploration horror game with psychedelic visuals and a harsh noise soundtrack. Explore multiple levels featuring puzzle platforming elements and hidden items, while chaotic FMVs play in sync with the music, creating an inescapable audiovisual nightmare that continuously changes as you explore it. Engage with the temptation of Lucifer and gaze upon his works. The game explores Lucifer as a metaphor for humanity's capacity for malice. Platforming sections are interspersed with cutscenes during which Lucifer will show you what he has done, and ask you to join him. Watch as Christ's message is contorted and abused by the powers that be. Environments and in-game videos depict the resurgence of Christofascism in the United States of America, and how its proponents publicly and privately act in ways that are directly contradictory to the teachings of Jesus of Nazareth.  Love each other. -Mared Jurphy Special thanks to Tyler Jordan and Curtis Krommenhoek for play-testing LIGHT-BRINGER, and to Chloe Murphy for her invaluable insight throughout the development process. Made using FMOD Studio by Firelight Technologies Pty Ltd.
row.short_description: LIGHT-BRINGER is a first-person exploration horror game with psychedelic visuals and a harsh noise soundtrack. Explore 3D platforming environments with puzzles and mazes reflecting facets of American Christianity, collect hidden Sacred Hearts, and confront Lucifer's temptation.
row.reviews: “Mared Jurphy takes all types of light, from nuclear blast to the muzzle flash of spree killers, as American luciferian energy. The impossible space of this platformer collect-a-thon slaps you with a rare integration of videoludic harsh noise, both sonic and visual.” Frédérick Maheux, Interactive Noise “A surreal and chaotic critique about the state of Christianity in America. Featuring a mix of gameplay genres and an awesome soundtrack (if you’re into harsh noise), this is a trip that’s also food for thought.” Weird Fucking Games

row.name: Gotchi Guardians - Tower Defense
row.detailed_description: Flex your strategic muscles with Gotchi Guardians — a chaotic, multiplayer roguelite tower defense game. Face off against seven other players as you build cute, devastating defenses to protect your Guardian from relentless waves of evil Licks. Adapt to unpredictable events, counter your opponents’ strategies, and outlast the madness to become the last Guardian standing! Meet the Guardians From stubborn tanks to greedy misfits, every Guardian plays differently—and brings their own twist to the battlefield. 🛡️ Knight – A stalwart defender who punishes attackers by reflecting their damage. Ideal for players who like to stand their ground—and make it hurt. 🍎 Farmer – A cheerful oddball who buffs towers by spraying them with apple juice and distracting enemies with inflatable decoys. It shouldn’t work. It does anyway. 💰 Soldier of Fortune – A slick opportunist who turns gold into power. Earn bonus income by acting fast, soaking damage, or cashing out at just the right moment. A total of 6 Guardians are available at launch, including the Pirate, the Archer, and the magic Shaaman—each offering a different playstyle for every kind of strategist. Earn XP as you play and unlock unique talents for each Guardian, letting you grow stronger no matter how you choose to play. Risk, Reward, Repeat Every match brings a new set of twists through the dynamic event system. Choose which towers to unlock, how many more enemies everyone should face, and what kind of upgrades the enemy Licks will gain—like exploding gas tanks or super sticky giant bullets for Steady Lads. Every decision affects the flow of battle. Event choices grant rewards like Income, Items, and Upgrade Seeds, which unlock powerful tower evolutions. At the end of every 5-round day, all players must survive the rampage of a powerful Boss Lick! Climb the seasonal leaderboards by earning Stars and Star Dust through consistent play. Survive longer, place higher, and unlock G-Bucks, cosmetics, and more at season’s end. A world worth saving The Gotchiverse may be digital, but it’s packed with whimsical landmarks and adorable creatures. Every map offers a fresh setting with wild mechanics and surprise events that force players to adapt—or get licked. 🌿 Prong Meadow – A lush forest where strategy is grounded—literally. Toggle a central bridge (for a price!) to block enemy paths or open new ones, and watch out for events that reroute the horde from below. 💧 Rickety River – Two bridges. Two crabs. Infinite sabotage. Defend the central island while deciding which bridge gets the moving crab tower platform next—because once it’s placed, it’s everyone’s problem. 🔥 Mount Oomf – Pure mayhem. Lava, landslides, and the mighty Fomosaurus , a mythical dinosaur that attacks anything in sight—Licks or Guardians. Pay to spawn even stronger versions and unleash them on everyone . Fireballs optional. Regret guaranteed. From serene meadows to volcano-choked arenas, every location is a test of timing, tactics, and just a little bit of trolling. And this is just the beginning—new maps, events, and surprises are already in the works. Key Features 🛡️ 8-player multiplayer tower defense mayhem 🎯 Distinct Guardians with unique abilities and talent trees 🌀 Dynamic events that reshape every run 🌋 Wild arenas filled with hazards, surprises, and mega-bosses 🧠 Deep progression with cross-Guardian XP and unlocks 🏆 Seasonal leaderboards, rewards, cosmetics and bragging rights Join the Fight Gotchi Guardians is just getting started. New Guardians, towers, bosses, Licks, items, maps, and events are all in the works—and we’re building it hand-in-hand with our community. Led by veteran developer Jason Slama ( GWENT , The Witcher series), Gotchi Guardians is being shaped by real player feedback at every stage. Join the dev team and fellow Guardians on our official Discord to share ideas, report bugs, earn bounties and stay up to date on all the latest news.

row.short_description: Explore, grow, repair and cook delicious food! Harvest Cafe combines an open-world adventure with a restaurant business simulation, giving you the opportunity to enjoy farm life.

row.name: 合金子弹
row.detailed_description: 《合金子弹》是一款独具匠心的卡牌游戏，将可爱画风与热血战斗完美融合。游戏中，那些圆滚滚、萌态百出的 Q 版坦克造型，瞬间就能俘获你的心，每一辆都被精心绘制，细节满满，仿佛带着生命力跃然屏上。 欢迎来到《合金子弹》的精彩世界！这款游戏将可爱的画风与激烈的战斗完美结合，让你在收集萌萌的坦克的同时，也能体验到策略战斗的乐趣。本攻略将为你详细讲解通关技巧，助你快速上手，成为最强指挥官！ 合金子弹头通关教学 一、卡牌收集与养成 在《合金子弹》中，坦克卡牌是你的主要战斗力。首先，了解不同坦克的类型至关重要，包括：输出型、防御型、辅助型等。根据你的队伍需求，合理搭配坦克。通过每日任务、活动奖励以及抽卡获得新的坦克卡牌。重点培养核心坦克，优先提升其等级和技能。等级提升可以增加坦克的生命值、攻击力、防御力等属性，技能升级则能增强战斗力，例如：提高伤害、增加控制、提供保护等。 别忘了为坦克装备合适的装备，装备的强化与升级能进一步提升坦克的作战能力。 二、战斗策略与技巧 在战斗中，合理的阵容搭配至关重要。通常来说，一个平衡的阵容应该包括：一定数量的输出型坦克，保障伤害；一到两个防御型坦克，在前排吸收伤害；以及合金子弹怎么通关的辅助型坦克，提供增益效果。 战斗开始前，仔细观察敌方阵容，并根据敌方的特点，调整你的阵容。 战斗过程中，合理使用技能是关键。在能量足够时，优先释放核心坦克的强力技能，迅速击溃敌方。 灵活调整战斗策略，例如：在敌方控制技能较多时，可以考虑增加己方坦克的韧性，或者使用免疫控制的技能。 此外，善用集火目标，优先消灭敌方高输出或者辅助单位。 熟悉不同地图的地形，利用地形优势，例如：优先攻击掩体后的敌人，可以有效降低己方受到的伤害。 三、资源获取与利用 合金子弹头通关教学 游戏中，资源获取主要依赖每日任务、活动奖励、以及合金子弹通关教程通关副本。钻石是重要的货币，可以用于购买抽卡券、体力等。合理规划钻石使用，避免浪费。 每天完成日常任务，获得经验、金币、以及其他奖励，提升等级，解锁更多功能。 积极参与游戏内的各种活动，例如：限时挑战、竞技场等，获得额外的资源和奖励。 充分利用游戏内的各种功能，例如：离线挂机，获得金币和经验，加速坦克养成。 金币是游戏内另一重要资源，主要用于坦克升级和装备强化。合理分配金币资源，保证核心坦克的培养。 记住，量力而行。 不要为了追求进度而过度消费，合理安排游戏时间，享受游戏的乐趣。 四、竞技场与挑战 竞技场是检验你队伍实力的好地方。 通过参与竞技场，可以与其他玩家切磋，提升排名，获得奖励。 挑战更高难度的副本，解锁更多奖励和坦克碎片。 提升实力的方法是： 持续培养你的主力队伍； 分析对手的阵容，并根据对手的阵容，调整你的策略； 积极参加每日活动，获取各种资源； 利用游戏内的辅助功能，提升游戏体验。 掌握以上技巧，你就能在《合金子弹》的世界里，所向披靡！祝你游戏愉快！
row.short_description: 《合金子弹》是一款独具匠心的卡牌游戏，将可爱画风与热血战斗完美融合。

Echoveil : The Last Guest
row.detailed_description: “Every guest who checked in… was never seen again.” stumble across a half-abandoned motel deep in the woods. It looks lived-in. Warm lights glow in the hallways. There’s luggage left behind. But no one answers the bell. In Echoveil: The Last Guest , you play as a lone Journalist seeking shelter —only to uncover a chilling secret hiding behind every door. The motel seems to breathe. Rooms shift. Shadows move where they shouldn’t. And something… or someone… is watching you. 🔍 Explore. Listen. Escape. 🗝️ Explore the motel and uncover its past through forgotten journals, eerie sounds, and the belongings of guests who vanished. 🪞 Experience psychological horror without cheap jumpscares—only subtle tension, shifting spaces, and things that shouldn’t exist. 🧠 Find clues 🎮 Designed for: Fans of narrative horror and walking sims Players who enjoy atmospheric, emotional mysteries Short-form story experiences (20–30 minutes) Will you escape the motel... or become its last guest?
row.short_description: A short, atmospheric first-person horror game set in an abandoned motel where guests vanish without a trace. Explore, uncover secrets, and escape before becoming the next lost soul

row.name: Soluna's Mood
row.detailed_description: Soluna's Mood 🌞🌙 A minimalist weather widget with personality! A minimalist desktop weather widget that comes to life! Watch as Sol (the sun) and Luna (the moon) react to weather changes and time of day. Each has their own distinct personality—discover their quirks as you interact! Press keys and see how Sol or Luna respond. Earn points, collect hats, and help your celestial pals thrive! ✨ Features: Living Widget Characters Sol is lively and expressive (frowns in rain, cheers in sunshine) Luna is a dreamy introvert (shows moon phases, yawns at dawn) Reactions based on real-time weather data Collect & Customize Unlock stylish accessories : sunglasses, nightcaps, seasonal outfits Change Sol & Luna’s appearance to match your mood Interactive Fun Earn points by clicking ( Bongo Cat-style mechanics! ) Discover hidden reactions the more you interact Weather Forecast Stay updated on current conditions Get friendly advice from Sol & Luna—they mean well! 🖥️ Tech Specs: Always-on-top mode Low resource usage (lightweight performance) Adjustable transparency 🚀 Unlike static weather widgets, Sol & Luna are digital pets with real emotions!
row.short_description: 'Soluna's Mood' - a cute weather widget with personality! Sol & Luna react to weather and your clicks. Collect accessories and enjoy their emotions. Lightweight with transparency controls.

row.name: The End of the Sun: Prologue
row.detailed_description: The End of the Sun: Prologue is a part of the full version of the game, The End of the Sun. It includes the beginning of the game and one mission that provides an opportunity to delve deeper into the Slavic world and learn the basic game mechanics . Materials such as trailers and screenshots available on the website are also from the full version of the game. The End of the Sun is a first-person, adventure, story-driven mystery game, set in the fantasy world of Slavic beliefs, legends, and mythical creatures. The small village becomes a place of enigmatic events, through which the line between myth and reality begins to fade perilously. Unravel the secrets flickering in the fire! As the ashter, a Slavic sage sorcerer gifted with the ability to travel in time and knowledge about the otherworld, following the trail of the unusual fugitive, you come to a mysterious village. Unfortunately, you cannot find anyone there, at least not in the way you expected to. All you can see around you are burned hearths. The game is inspired by Slavic mythology and legends. The story presents the mysterious events occurring during the major Slavic festivals in all four seasons, far away from each other in time. The gameplay is a mix of exploration and adventure mystery games with unorthodox riddles to solve, but the storyline comes first here. FEATURE LIST Photogrammetry of ethnographic museums – To get unique graphics, we visited ethnographic museums. We scanned hundreds of objects and entire buildings, so you can admire them in the game the way they actually are. Time travel – Teleport between four main seasons far away from each other by many years. Get to know the stories of the same heroes at different stages of their lives. Use your power to solve the mystery! Non-linear and engaging story – Experience particular immersive stories at your own pace and at the moment you feel like it. Consequences of time manipulation – Set the paths of fate and bring the course of events back on the right track to discover further fragments of the game world and story. Events from the past have an impact on the future. Slavic culture – Enjoy not only the immersive story but also look at the long-forgotten everyday activities and objects that are no longer used today. Exploration and Open World – Travel between the homesteads and the surroundings of the village, discovering pieces of the mystery that lies somewhere there. Dynamic environment – The time of day, weather, and lighting change smoothly and dynamically right before your eyes as you discover parts of the mystery.
row.short_description: The End of the Sun: Prologue is a first-person, story-driven mystery adventure set in a Slavic fantasy world. As the ashter, a sage sorcerer gifted with the ability to travel in time, you come to a mysterious village where the line between myth and reality begins to fade perilously.
row.reviews: “Get ready for truly witcher-like encounters and investigations involving mythological creatures such as drowners or nightwraiths, the rituals of Forefathers’ Eve, Kupala Night, and even mushroom trips in the company of the kind-hearted Slavic god Svarog.” CD-Action “A title that has been in development for many years, but after this long wait, it manages to be highly appreciated for the depth of the stories woven into the narrative and its rather stunning technical and graphical quality, very close to another similar work: What Remains of Edith Finch.” Gamescore “Clearly nothing was done half-heartedly in the development of this game, and I thoroughly enjoyed my time with it. It definitely sparked my own wanderlust, and is sure to kindle the interest of anyone who appreciates exploring other historical cultures.” Adventure Game Hot Spot
developers: The End of the Sun Team
publishers: The End of the Sun Forge

row.name: The Population Must Grow
row.detailed_description: This is a very simple city builder game with the main purpose of scaling up your population. You can place build orders for your citizens to build new homes, plant food or plant new trees. The more citizens you have the faster the city can grow.  For me as the developer of this game, the purpose was to try to write efficient code to see how much a PC can handle before it begins to slow down. So try out and see how many citizens your device can handle.
row.short_description: Start with just one citizens to build up your city. Grow it more and more and more. There is no limit in size. Just the limit of your own PC.

row.name: Burger Shift: Team Rush: Prologue
row.detailed_description: DISCORD COMMUNITY About the Game The Prologue is a free intro to “Burger Shift: Team Rush” 🍔 Take your first bite before the full game drops. Jump in solo or team up with up to 8 players in co-op. Host your own session or join others through the in-game lobby, using built-in voice and text chat to stay connected as you take on the rush. Run every part of a bustling fast food kitchen, from operating fryers and soda fountains to flipping burgers on the grill. Learn the ins and outs of each station to keep things running smoothly. Expect the unexpected: chaotic events, strange customers, and surprise challenges demand quick thinking and solid teamwork. Communication and coordination are your tools for success. Stay sharp and manage your time wisely. Keep orders flowing and customers happy by assigning roles, juggling priorities, and working as one unstoppable crew. What’s Included in the Prologue? Order up! Here’s what’s on the menu in the Prologue: Single-player and 1–8 player co-op – Run the kitchen solo or with friends. A selection of signature ingredients and recipes – Including baked goods, frying, and burger prep. Soda fountain and coffee machine – Serve cold sodas and hot coffee to keep your customers satisfied. Character customization – Pick your gear and show off your style with early outfit and character options.
row.short_description: Run the world's most chaotic fast food joint! Play solo or with up to 8 friends as you take orders, make burgers, and hustle to keep customers happy. Grow your business with every shift.

row.name: Побег в Москву 2
row.detailed_description: Continuation of the visual novel Escape to Moscow. Game genre: visual novel. The game takes place in modern Russia, some time after the events of the bad ending of the first part. The main character will try to correct his mistakes and again rushes to meet adventures! In this game, you will have to help your friend Aliya escape from home again. During the game, you will need to make choices that will affect the plot. An exciting journey awaits you in Moscow and beyond. The goal of the game is to achieve a happy ending, which depends on the choices you make during the game. You will find: More than 6 playable characters. 6 game days. 3 hours of exciting gameplay. More than 10 locations.
row.short_description: This is a visual novel - a continuation of the game Escape to Moscow. More than 3 hours of gameplay, 6 game days. Immerse yourself in new adventures in Moscow and other locations. You need to help Aliya escape to freedom again! The plot of the game depends on the decisions you make.
