Vengeance
row.detailed_description: Vengeance is a fast-paced 2D bullet hell roguelike where survival depends on your reflexes, positioning, and ability to stay calm in chaos. Dive into arenas flooded with enemies, dodge an onslaught of projectiles, and stay alive for as long as you can. Each session ramps up the intensity — no grinding, no inventory, just you against overwhelming odds. The longer you survive, the more brutal it gets. Core Features: • 🌀 Pure bullet hell action – survive wave after wave of relentless enemies • ⏱️ Tight, responsive controls – your movement is your greatest weapon • 🔥 Skill-based progression – improve through mastery, not loot • 🎮 Short, intense sessions – perfect for quick adrenaline bursts • 🎲 Over 10 unique enemy types that evolve across levels • 👹 2 handcrafted boss encounters , each with multiple phases and unique mechanics
row.short_description: Face endless waves. Dodge. Survive. Repeat. Vengeance is a fast-paced 2D bullet hell roguelike where you're thrown into a chaotic battlefield swarming with enemies. Master your movement, survive as long as you can. Every second counts, and one wrong step means game over.
row.notes: The game contains stylised fantasy violence, including combat against monsters and bosses using weapons and abilities.

row.name: Parallel Convergence
row.detailed_description: Story You play as Ryu, an engineering student who, alongside his eccentric best friend Seishun, dreams of building a time machine after a groundbreaking discovery by a research institute named STERN. What begins as a wild idea quickly grows into a deeply personal mission — one that will test friendship, love, loss, and the limits of human determination. As you navigate lively debates, playful banter, and the chaos of student life, you will recruit old friends and unexpected allies. Together, you’ll face academic hurdles, personal regrets, and the hilarious realities of trying to change the world from a cramped student apartment (with a perpetually hungry cat named Helios). Will you and your friends go down in history as the first to conquer time—or will reality catch up before you can change it? Key Features Branching Narrative Make choices that influence character relationships, major plot events, and the ultimate outcome of the story. Hours of Story Content Dive into 5+ hours of dialogue-rich storytelling across multiple chapters. Multiple Endings Your choices matter. Explore different conclusions based on your decisions, with endings that reflect the heart—or cost—of chasing the impossible. A Cat That Steals the Show Your apartment may be small, but Helios the cat has a big personality—and even bigger appetite. Multiple Save Slots & Skip Functions Play your way with features like save, load, and fast-forward for replaying branches or discovering alternate outcomes.
row.short_description: A time travel project. A group of students. A cat that eats too much. Can you rewrite fate without losing what matters most?
row.notes: This game includes general mature themes that may not be appropriate for all age groups or for display at work.

row.name: Lust By Appointment : Prologue
row.detailed_description: Welcome to your story. You weren’t always a male escort. You were just someone behind the bar — a smooth-talking bartender with nothing but a shaker in your hand and a dream too dangerous to say out loud. Until she walked in. Loretta. A bestselling author. Powerful. Polished. Controlled. She hires you—not for pleasure, but as a source. She wants to hear your story for her next novel. But your story isn't just about sex. It's about power, temptation, and what happens when you fall too deep. You tell her about Maria—your stunning, fearless boss. The woman who owns the bar... and nearly owns your heart. You talk about the jealous ex she couldn't quite shake, and how that drama almost pulls you under. Then there’s Vankra — the charming, nerdy girl with a dirty laugh and the ability to make your pulse race just by looking at you. And of course… Aurae. Bold. Aggressive. Unapologetic. She didn’t flirt — she hunted. And we can't forget about all the other important women whomst story will be told on another time. Kala, the wife of a powerful mafia boss who seems to have everything, but behind closed doors, her influential, dominant husband can’t satisfy her. By his permission she seeks out for you—someone who can give her the pleasure and excitement her marriage can't provide. Svara, the cutie who entertains you on her live stream every other night. A girl you can only look at but can't touch. You can't get enough of her. Nova, a supermodel, boasting a beautiful face and slender body, and a wild side you can't really ignore. She teases and gets in to your head—it's driving you crazy. But apart from all of that, she cares a lot about her sister, Vankra. Elara, the woman who stands behind the scene. With her elegance and power, she controls and runs the escort business. But behind all the glitz and glamour, she finds herself longing for something real—something money can’t buy—something that can fill the loneliness in her heart. As you share each memory, Loretta listens. But something starts to change. She’s no longer just taking notes. She’s leaning in. She’s fantasizing. She’s unraveling. Hearing about your encounters drives her wild — until she can no longer hide the dark, forbidden hunger inside her. You thought you were just telling your story. But you’re becoming part of hers. This is only the beginning. Lust By Appointment: Prologue is your first step into a world of erotic power plays, twisted relationships, and dangerous desire. Are you ready to confess… everything ?
row.short_description: Lust By Appointment is a story-focused adult visual novel where you as a player experience what its like to be a male escort. It isn't just about sex, it's about the deep connection created with each client you meet throughout the entire story.
row.notes: Sexual acts and nudity. Frequent sex scenes. Small amount of sexual assault. Mature languages.

row.name: BIGGEST PIANO
row.detailed_description: Welcome to a very special concert. It all starts with one strange thing: The piano is just… way too big. Biggest Piano is a short, comedic horror adventure. It's supposed to be scary—but probably isn't. A strange letter arrives at the office of detective Ota. It's from Shoko, a music student and pianist. The location? A concert hall still in operation. Together with his companions Takeru and Makoto, Ota begins investigating. Everything seems normal. A little too normal. And then the piano starts to grow. Something appears—drawn to the sound—something that never stops playing. It’s scary but funny. Funny, but kind of scary. But really… it’s probably not that scary. Can you break the curse and save Shoko? Your senses are the score. The escape is your finale. The curtain rises on the most unforgettable concert of the year. Fear plays in fortissimo. Will you ever reach the final rest? Biggest Piano is a 20-minute horror adventure game that begins with a single, unsettling realization: “Something’s wrong with the piano.” 🎹 Designed for players who aren’t good with horror—this game is spooky, but not too scary. 😅 No jump scares or gore. Just a mysterious, slightly cursed piano. 🖱 Controls are kept simple for accessibility. 🐭 A mouse-only mode is available so you can even move without touching the keyboard. Great as an introductory horror game for first-time players. And it's totally free—so give it a try and enjoy the concert! 🎵  Two big endings! Simple controls: Move with WASD, look with your mouse!  Big laughs and thrills—for free! (It's a birthday gift for the developer’s daughter!) Note: This game was developed somewhere between horror and comedy. Occasionally, the piano may grow to a size not intended by the developer. If this occurs, please report the piano size in your review. Streaming & Content Creation: You're welcome to stream or share content from this game! For details and contact info, please see our [official website].
row.short_description: A short comedic horror adventure where you investigate the mystery of a piano that won’t stop growing.
row.notes: This game contains mild horror elements and supernatural themes that may be disturbing to some players.

row.name: One/Iro
row.detailed_description: Dylan has lost everything and now he wants to forget everything, help him on his short journey. DEVELOPMENT One/Iro is a 3D first-person puzzle game, it was made for Cinegame-jam and now it has been revisited and is available for everyone. AN ADVENTURE IN THE HUMAN SOUL Follow Dylan on his journey through dreams and discover what happened to him and his family. Find his memories and the pieces to complete the dream machine. EXPLORATION Explore the levels to discover all the endings! The game features several levels to explore, to move from and from one level to another, completing the puzzles to progress. Search the rooms for the objects needed to continue.
row.short_description: Dylan has lost everything and now wants to forget everything, help him in this little journey. One/Iro is a 3D first person puzzle game, explore the rooms to find letters and parts of the dream machine so you can discover the truth.
row.notes: Mention of alcohol use

row.name: Ghostmoons - Arcade
row.detailed_description: Ghostmoons - Arcade, is a vehicle based first person shooter, focusing on last second rapid movement or strafing, to avoid projectiles and attacks. Your goal is to remove the unknown military's portals from the moons of the Ghostmoons system, while avoiding collateral damage of the native life forms. Navigate swarms of incoming rockets and machine gun fire, to engage military positions, if the native life forms aren't in the way. Unintentional casualties are unavoidable, but with a winning mission, and some windfall, the native life forms can be resurrected.
row.short_description: Ghostmoons - Arcade, is a vehicle based first person shooter, focusing on rapid movements or strafing, to avoid projectiles and attacks. Your goal is to remove the unknown military's portals from the moons of the Ghostmoons system, while avoiding collateral damage of the native life forms.

row.name: Tactical2
row.detailed_description: Tactical2 is a turn-based strategy board game where two teams of ancient Greek deities clash across a 10x10 grid. Deploy your divine champions, control their movements, and unleash powerful abilities to outmaneuver your opponent. Each turn, you’ll move two characters and perform two actions (attack, shield, and more) as you fight to cross into enemy territory. Victory goes to the first player to reach the opposite side of the board. Choose your gods wisely, master their powers, and claim your place among the legends.
row.short_description: Tactical2 is a turn-based strategy board game where two teams of ancient Greek deities battle for supremacy across a 10x10 grid. Take command of powerful gods, deploy them wisely, and harness divine abilities to crush your enemies and invade their territory!
row.notes: The game is about character combat, although there are no depiction of violence, gore or blood, the concept itself might be unsuitable for certain audiences.

row.name: Knight Crawler
row.detailed_description: Step into the boots of Cyrus, a medieval knight trapped in an endless dungeon. Knight Crawler  is a top-down action roguelike where each run is unpredictable, unforgiving, and ruthless. Explore procedurally generated rooms (or depth) that change with every playthrough Challenges Each room entered poses a new challenge, whether that be a new enemy, an enhanced previous enemy, or an increased number of enemies. As you dive deeper, you face foes ranging from a little rat to an uncontrollable wizard shooting flurries of fireballs. The challenge isn't just to survive, but to adapt. Key Features On your journey, you will encounter health potions, weapons, shops, and blacksmiths. Collect coins to purchase and upgrade your weapons. Weapons can have up to 6 modifiers, ranging from simple damage boosts to lightning, lifesteal, and legendaries. Credits Music and Sound: Lev Strider Enemy Artwork: Olivia Sofranko (IG: @oliviasofr) Main Character Design: Cooper Green All other aspects (programming, environment, design, etc.): Taylor Conolley
row.short_description: Play as Cyrus, a medieval knight, in this top-down action roguelike. Battle your way through endless procedurally generated dungeons filled with coins and weapons. Discover rare, powerful modifiers and test your skills against a variety of deadly foes.

row.name: Stellar Witch
row.detailed_description: Become a Stellar Witch and engage in magical battles across the cosmos! Harness the power of constellations and grow into a powerful grand sorceress! Defeat waves of powerful enemies, collect gold, and acquire even stronger constellation tiles. How long can you survive against increasingly stronger foes? Game Overview Stellar Witch is a unique inventory-management + dodge-action roguelike game where you become a witch mastering the power of constellations. It features strategic constellation placement and fast reflex gameplay. Game Features Strategic Inventory Management Collect constellation tiles in five tiers: Common, Rare, Epic, Legendary, and Mythical. Each constellation has a unique size, shape, ability, and adjacency effect. Placing constellations next to each other can trigger special synergy effects. Find the optimal layout within limited space! Grid-based Real-Time Dodge Action Intense 1:1 battles against monsters Step on constellation tiles to instantly activate their powers. Combine attack, defense, and debuff abilities to your advantage. Read enemy patterns and move quickly to survive! Try new constellation setups each time and see how long you can survive against ever-stronger enemies!
row.short_description: 'Stellar Witch' is a grid-dodge action game with inventory management. Become a star-powered witch on a journey to become the Grand Mage. Collect gold in battle, buy and place constellations, and use their powers and synergies to fight ever-stronger enemies.

row.name: Echoes of Time
row.detailed_description: 'Echoes of Times' is a narrative independent game developed based on RPG Maker MV, focusing on free exploration and character interaction. Players will play the role of a protagonist lost in a world of time and space. By exploring the map, talking to different NPCs and completing exclusive tasks, they will gradually uncover the truth hidden in the 'Echoes of Time'. This game adopts a free exploration advancement method, and the player's choice will affect the direction and ending of the story. In the process of solving puzzles and advancing tasks, you will face a deep discussion about memory, fate and choice. Whether you like plot exploration, logical reasoning, or a casual player with light challenges, 'Echoes of Times' can bring you a relaxing and thoughtful game journey. Game Features: Free exploration gameplay: No linear advancement is required, players can freely shuttle between multiple areas to unlock hidden content and side stories. Minimalist art style and immersive sound effects: The elegant visual style and soothing background music that match the atmosphere of the story create a unique emotional experience. Story structure with variable endings: Player behavior will determine the final direction of the game, bringing high replay value. Lightweight experience suitable for all players: no high operation threshold, more emphasis on emotional resonance and narrative immersion.
row.short_description: Echoes of Times is a narrative-driven adventure game about memory, time, and human connection. Explore a fragmented world filled with mysterious NPCs, complete interactive tasks, and unlock multiple story paths and emotional endings shaped by your choices.

row.name: Hog Heist
row.detailed_description: You crashed into the world's most valuable museum! Grab as many valuable pieces without getting caught by the security guards and police officers! Explore The Massive Museums Prehistoric Dinosaur Area, Space Exhibit, Science Museum, and More to explore and discover. Steal Everything. Even the Guards & Officers!!!   Almost everything you see, you can steal. From art pieces, to dinosaur skeletons, to people, to the bathroom sign. Beautiful High-Speed Powerups Sprint through the map with fun, high speed ramps that give you a boost as you travel. Rank in the Online Leaderboards Compete against gamers all around the world to score the highest value and the fastest time.
row.short_description: Don't get caught as you explore large museum exhibits, steal valuable items, evade law enforcement, and race back to your getaway truck in this exciting arcade game.

row.name: Cute Warrior Girl (큐트 여전사)
row.detailed_description: This game is an adventure story about a young female warrior set in a medieval world. This is a simple yet enjoyable action-adventure game where a cute female warrior defeats the orcs that are harming the villagers. Talk to NPCs in the royal palace and the forest to gather hints and track down the hidden orc hideout. Your combat abilities change based on the experience you earn, leading to multiple endings where you may defeat the orc or suffer defeat. With simple controls (arrow keys + spacebar), anyone can easily play, and the average playtime is around 10–15 minutes. It’s a charming mini-game featuring adorable characters, a short but immersive story, and lighthearted humor. One day, orcs began appearing in rural villages throughout the kingdom, committing acts of looting and violence. They were so quick and targeted only the weakest villages, making it nearly impossible for the royal army to defend or keep up with them. Mercenary knights were hired and sent into the orcs’ lair, but none of them ever returned. To prevent further destruction, the king made a bold declaration: any mercenary who could defeat the orcs would be granted any wish they desired. Upon hearing this, the confident warrior Fiora visited the king and boldly declared that she would take down the orcs herself. Although this game appears to follow a JRPG style, it is actually closer to a simple adventure game. It can be completed in a short amount of time, and even those unfamiliar with JRPGs will find it easy to play. Controls: Move: Arrow Keys Talk/Interact: Spacebar
row.short_description: The 16-year-old warrior's name is Fiora. This game is an adventure story about a young female warrior set in a medieval world.

row.name: Masquerade
row.detailed_description: Abducted by the dangerous Theater, Juliet has been turned into a puppet. Guided by the mysterious Narrator, Romeo will embark on a twisted journey through faux decors, rotating sets, and deceptive backstages. What secrets lie beneath the Theater? Inspired by the original Romeo and Juliet of Shakespeare, rediscover key beats of their tragedy in this expansive 3D reimagination. Explore the Theater and its mysteries in this fully voiced immersive narrative adventure, follow Romeo and the Narrator in their quest to save Juliet, but be wary of the lights… Who knows, maybe you’ll even find out what’s hiding below the stage? Explore a story’s worth of beautiful hand-crafted theater sets. Solve more than a dozen real-time puzzles containing rotating sets, dangerous lights, and varied challenges. Experience a fully-voiced original story inspired by the world of the theater. Move through a classic three-act structure as the story progresses. Immerse yourself in a spectacle, from start to finish, and play as its main actor. Live through the narration in English or in French (voices only available in English). Masquerade is a Graduation Project by ARTFX Promo 2025’s students, in collaboration with sound designers from Slope Audio Training, a composer from MAAV, and two talented voice actors. Led and united under a common vision of the project, they worked together for over a year to create this game. No compromise, only passion. We hope you’ll like it. Made with Unreal Engine 5.4 Playing with a controller is recommended.
row.short_description: Inspired by Shakespeare’s Romeo and Juliet, explore a mysterious 3D theater in this immersive, fully voiced adventure. Follow Romeo and the Narrator on a quest to save Juliet—but beware of the lights…

row.name: Terminus
row.short_description: Paris, 1968. As the city sinks into social unrest, a far darker threat rises from deep underground. Charles Mercier, a former SOLDIER recruited by a secret organization, is sent into the METRO tunnels to prevent an IMMINENT CATASTROPHE.
row.notes: Gore, dismemberment, arachnophobia

row.name: That One Otter Game
row.detailed_description: That One Otter Game is a mischievous co-op adventure where two young otters take on a wild rite of passage to prove their worth. Complete silly park challenges to fill up your stamp card—catch a panicked penguin, race a hyped-up zebra, or haul a stolen radio to a mountaintop.                                                        Yeet stuff everywhere, hijack a tiny car to smash fences (or bump into a few unsuspecting bystanders), and meet all kinds of animals: shy penguins, chill elephants, or chatty otters to bicker with.                                   Explore a vibrant world full of surprises, unlock hidden hats to strut in style, and let your imagination run wild—you never know what’ll happen next.                                  Built for two players on the same couch, the game thrives on exploration, dumb ideas, and chaotic fun. Everything reacts in weird ways, and every corner hides a new giggle.                                                 That One Otter Game is a fuzzy mix of nonsense, cuteness, and wet fur—a joyful sandbox where the goal isn’t just to win, but to cause delightful mayhem like two otters on a sugar rush.
row.short_description: That One Otter Game is a mischievous co-op adventure where two young otters take on a wild rite of passage to prove their worth. Complete silly park challenges to fill up your stamp card—catch a panicked penguin, race a hyped-up zebra, or haul a stolen radio to a mountaintop.

row.name: Maze

row.name: Kebabstar: Prologue🌯
row.detailed_description: KEBABSTAR PROLOGUE: MORE THAN A GAME While average gamers waste their time on rigid, static scripts, you will encounter a living, breathing system in Kebabstar that thinks for itself and dares to challenge your intellect. ONLY SLAVES FEED FROM THE MASTER'S HAND. Some evil corporations in Israel, US and England are feeding you sugar-coated chains. BITING IS NOT ENOUGH. ANNIHILATE THE CULT IN CYPRUS ! Witness the extraordinary and epic journey of a humble kebab seller who becomes an Agent after losing everything in the desert. Your mission? To destroy this sinister cult and the tech company behind it deep within the Cyprus. From flipping kebabs on the streets to partying in luxury parties, you’ll rise through the ranks and transform into an elite agent . In this epic and hilarious simulation, cook  kebabs, charm the ladies, and shoot the fire ! Kebabstar 'Prologue' contains : Innovative physics based cooking gameplay available. Total 3 of chapters available in total of 12 chapters. Arabia, Dubai and Grand Bazaar worlds available to play. Kebabstar 'Prologue' does not contains : Shooting gameplay mechanics is not available on  Kebabstar Prologue. Cyprus Island is not available on Kebabstar Prologue. Some of characters are not available on Kebabstar Prologue . The Ice Cream cult content is not available on Kebabstar Prologue. KEBABSTAR: MORE THAN A GAME 'ONLY SLAVES EAT FROM THE MASTER'S HAND.' The US, UK, and Israel companies are feeding you chains wrapped in sugar. BITING IS NOT ENOUGH. DEVOUR THE CULT. Witness the authentic and epic journey of a humble kebab seller who becomes an AI agent after losing everything in the desert. Your mission? To seek and destroy this sinister cult and the tech company behind it. - Player remains as a kebab seller throughout in our 'Kebabstar Prologue' game. From flipping kebabs on the streets to partying in luxury parties, you’ll rise through the ranks and transform into an elite AI Agent . In this epic and hilarious simulation, cook  kebabs, charm the ladies and  shoot the fire ! - No combat is present in the our 'Kebabstar Prologue' game.    Note : Shooting gameplay system is only available on our main game. FEEL YOUR REAL HANDS AND COOKING LIKE NEVER BEFORE You're not just an agent — you're stepping into the full cooking experience, one step at a time. Feel the grip of the knife, hold the pan, mix the ingredients, and become a true chef as you master the art of kebab-making . Unlike any other game, Kebabstar Prologue uses advanced inverse kinematics to deliver a hyper-realistic cooking experience where your hero’s hands move just like your own. ROLEPLAY AS CHEF You're not just an ordinary kebab master, you’re the hero of a wild tale rising to superstardom . With hilarious , funny , and unforgettable characters , we’re not exaggerating  you’ll feel them living inside you! EXTRAORDINARY STORYLINE  As you master the art of kebab-making, outsmart your rivals for your own gain, and become a social media sensation, you discover that your beloved camel was kidnapped by a dark cult named Ice Cream Cult and prisoned at the island. AN ACTION-SIM FILLED WITH ADVENTURE, LOVE & COMEDY After losing everything, you put on a mysterious pair of glasses and suddenly find yourself at a luxury party — with nothing left to your name. From the deserts to Cyprus, you’ll meet a blind man and begin an epic, super journey into the world of artificial intelligence espionage. EXCLUSIVE GRAPHICS Get ready to be blown away by the stunning visuals of Kebabstar Prologue . Powered by Unreal Engine 5, the game delivers an unmatched level of realism and immersion that transports you to a world like no other. A WORLD THAT FEELS ALIVE Every scene in Kebabstar Prologue is crafted with incredible attention to detail — from the bustling vendors of the Grand Bazaar to the sizzling grills of kebab stands. As you explore the vibrant world of Kebabstar Prologue, you’ll encounter characters and environments that feel so real, it’s like stepping into another life. IMMERSIVE ENVIRONMENTS Experience the thrill of stepping into a world where every kebab stand, lively setting, and eccentric character feels truly lifelike. This isn’t just one location — you’ll journey through Arabia, Dubai, and Istanbul, each with its own flavor of realism and storylines action. Note: The Cyprus Island is available in our main game.
row.short_description: World's first AI agentic game. Play as the first AI AGENT and also AGENT HERO. Go and confront your creators in Cyprus. Infinite worlds and infinite stories await, but you have one target: The power that made you. Break the simulation before it breaks you.
row.notes: The game contains limited nudity, alcohol and erotic dances. Some players may find these elements culturally sensitive or inappropriate.

row.name: Nighthold: Number 1
row.detailed_description: Welcome to the bright future of colonization with Cosmos Colonisation Corp™! You are greeted by the planet Sandrax-66b! It’s dusty. It’s harsh. It’s ours. You have arrived on the frontline of exploring a new world. And although your ship has somewhat… stopped being a ship, that’s no reason to despair. Cosmos Colonisation Corp™ believes in you! And when we believe — even you will survive. An open and fully destructible world Everything you see can be taken apart, destroyed, or set on fire. Experiment. Test. Break engineering ethics. Exploration of discoveries and anomalies Unknown object? Mysterious signal? A melted door in the middle of the desert? Of course, it’s safe! Expand the horizons of corporate knowledge. Daytime is for work. Nighttime is for survival. While it’s light — build, fortify, upgrade your gear. When darkness falls — prepare to face the locals. They’re not inclined to negotiate. Tactical freedom Follow orders. Or spectacularly break them. Sneak, attack head-on, unleash the Rot in the camp, or just burn everything down — Cosmos Colonisation Corp™ supports any choice you make. Building and fortifications Platforms, walls, campfires. Build your dream shelter. Everything can be built. Everything can be lost. Especially if you forget to close the door. Progress through disk modules Your experience is valuable! Save it on disks and enhance yourself and your equipment. ⸻ Cosmos Colonisation Corp™ — Reliable solutions for unstable worlds.
row.short_description: Investigate a starship crash, explore a hostile world, build shelters and survive nightly attacks of the Rot. Tear down any structure and experience total freedom of action.

row.name: Oasis Driver for Windows Mixed Reality
row.detailed_description: Oasis is a Windows 11 driver for SteamVR for VR headsets of the Windows Mixed Reality family, such as the HP Reverb, Samsung Odyssey, Lenovo Explorer, or Dell Visor. This driver does not require the Mixed Reality Portal application and is therefore compatible with the latest versions of Windows 11 (24H2 and future). The driver offers full headset and motion controller tracking as well as a native SteamVR rendering pipeline. It can run OpenVR and OpenXR applications through SteamVR. FULL DOCUMENTATION: Please   see the 'Visit Website' or 'View Manual' links. IMPORTANT: This driver requires and NVIDIA GRAPHICS CARDS or an AMD GRAPHICS CARD. There is no support for INTEL GRAPHICS CARDS due to limitations in the Intel drivers. IMPORTANT: This driver is targeted at Windows 11 users. If you are unwilling to upgrade from Windows 10 to Windows 11, this program is not for you, you may stay on Windows 10 and use the Mixed Reality Portal instead. Both of these restrictions are listed in the 'System Requirements' below, under 'Minimum'. If you cannot meet the minimum requirements, it is your problem, not the developer's problem nor a shortcoming of the application.
row.short_description: A SteamVR driver for your Windows Mixed Reality VR headset on Windows 11.

Explore the eerie quiet of an old roadside motel, uncover its dark secret, and survive the night before you become the next missing guest. ⚠️ Content Warning This game contains themes of isolation, confinement, psychological manipulation, and implied violence. It may be disturbing for some players. Player discretion is advised.
row.short_description: You play as a traveler stranded on a cold, stormy night after your car runs out of gas. With no signal and nowhere else to go, you follow your dying GPS to a small roadside motel— but what seems like a safe place quickly turns into something far more sinister.

row.name: wonderking
row.detailed_description: Key Features Job System: WonderKing begins with basic classes that can advance into multiple specialized paths as the character levels up. Each job has its own unique skills and combat style, allowing players to enjoy diverse gameplay experiences. Quest-Based Progression: Players develop their characters by completing a wide range of quests, which are deeply tied to the game’s storyline and lore. PvP and PvE Content: In addition to monster hunting, the game offers a variety of combat content such as player-versus-player battles (PvP), dungeon exploration, and boss raids. Costumes and Customization: Players can personalize their characters with various equipment, outfits, pets, and more, allowing for creative expression and individuality. Story Background The story revolves around a journey to find the 'WonderKing,' a legendary hero destined to save the world from an evil force threatening peace. Players take on the role of a protagonist with the potential to become the WonderKing, embarking on an adventure alongside various allies.
row.short_description: Genre: Free 2D Side-Scrolling MMORPG Key Features: Class selection and job advancement system Quest-based story progression Party play and guild system A wide variety of mounts, pets, and costume customization PvE dungeons and PvP content available

row.name: Boundless
row.detailed_description: Shirley, a brave young girl, embarks on a solo mission to rescue her robot friend Spark after a surprise attack by cosmic robot pirates. Determined to save her companion, she infiltrates the enemy spaceship—kicking off a fast-paced interstellar platforming adventure. Core Features 🔸 Story-Driven Adventure Follow Shirley’s heartfelt journey through a mysterious spacecraft as she braves danger and uncovers secrets in her quest to reunite with Spark. 🔸 Four Themed Levels Each stage presents unique challenges and visual styles: A cluttered scrapyard-like warehouse filled with moving machinery Defense laser corridors requiring precise movement High-speed interstellar escape sequences The final showdown against the pirate leader aboard the command bridge 🔸 Progressive Difficulty Levels grow increasingly complex, introducing new traps, enemies, and mechanics that test your reflexes and problem-solving skills. 🔸 Unique Gadgets & Power-Ups Unlock tools like the Jetpack for aerial movement and the Magnetic Orb for manipulating metallic objects. These abilities are key to progressing through multi-layered environments. 🔸 Integrated Puzzle Challenges Each level features cleverly designed puzzles, hidden keys, and secret paths. Progress requires both timing and logic—think fast and move smart. 🔸 Simple Keyboard Controls Designed for accessibility: Use C to confirm and interact Use Arrow Keys to move and navigate menus Responsive controls optimized for precision platforming 🔸 Stylized Visuals Low-poly 3D graphics with bold color contrast, bringing a clean and modern sci-fi aesthetic to life. 🔸 Immersive Audio Feedback In-game sounds dynamically respond to your actions: jumping, landing, activating traps, or triggering mechanisms—all heightening immersion. 🔸 No Microtransactions Enjoy a full, standalone single-player experience. No paywalls, ads, or in-game purchases. 🔸 Estimated Playtime 3–6 hours for a regular playthrough. Additional time required for full completion.
row.short_description: A 2.5D sci-fi platformer where you play as Shirley on a solo rescue mission. Unlock new abilities like jet-assisted jumps and magnetic powers to solve puzzles, avoid traps, and overcome enemy challenges. No microtransactions.

row.name: Stop Breaking My Castle!
row.detailed_description: 'Stop Breaking My Castle!' is a game designed from the perspective of monsters who are always getting beaten up. Every day, heroes invade the peaceful Demon Lord’s castle, killing monsters and smashing the castle walls before leaving. The Demon Lord and the monsters just want to live normal lives, but it’s been a long time since their home turned into someone else’s hunting ground for leveling up. As the player, you become the Demon Lord, summoning and evolving monsters to stop the heroes. Summon and place monsters. Summon monsters to defend against invading heroes! Heroes, driven by money and fame, have attacked the demon tribe who were living peacefully. Summon monsters to stop the heroes and protect the peace of the demon tribe. Auto Battle Punish the heroes with the summoned monsters! It's time to show the heroes, who were after gold and experience, the bitter taste of fear. Monsters fight automatically, so strategic placement is necessary! Evolution Evolve your monsters and make them stronger! It’s not just the heroes who get to level up. Punish the heroes who invade for experience points with even more powerful monsters! Over 20 powerful types of monsters are waiting to be summoned! Grinding Defeating heroes drops gold! You can collect it with your mouse (a cute bat can help you, too). Looting isn’t just for heroes. Invading heroes must leave everything behind. Of course, if a monster falls, you can gather their souls to gain experience!
row.short_description: A peaceful demon castle is attacked daily by heroes who smash walls and defeat monsters, turning it into a hunting ground. As the Demon Lord, you summon and evolve monsters to defend your home and stop the relentless heroes.

row.name: The Dreamcatcher
row.detailed_description: The Dreamcatcher is a proof of concept for a hand-drawn 2.5D adventure platformer where you explore a collection of floating islands as Kit, the Dreamcatcher. It contains some basic resource gathering minigames, directional combat, a few NPCs to chat with, and a few things that need to be repaired around the islands. It only takes around 15 minutes to experience everything, and can probably be completed in a few minutes if you know what you're doing. This was an entirely solo project, and there are not immediate plans to work on a full game as of now. Enjoy!
row.short_description: The Dreamcatcher is a proof of concept for a hand-drawn adventure platformer where you explore a collection of floating islands as Kit, the Dreamcatcher.

row.name: The Pub Life Simulator: Prologue
row.detailed_description: READY TO RUN YOUR OWN PUB? Step into the world of The Pub Life Simulator  Prologue and turn a small, run-down shop into the bar of your dreams. Serve amazing drinks, keep your guests happy, and grow your business with smart decisions. START FRESH, CLEAN UP, AND OPEN YOUR PUB Your first task is to tidy up the place. A clean and welcoming environment is the key to attracting customers. Use your initial budget wisely to get basic supplies and kick things off with a simple menu. EXPAND YOUR MENU AND MASTER YOUR CRAFT As you progress, unlock new ingredients, master recipes, and create drinks your guests will love. Experiment, develop your style, and make your mark on the neighborhood. BALANCE IS EVERYTHING Running a successful pub is about more than just pouring drinks. Manage your stock, control expenses, and respond to customer demands. Make smart investments or risk putting your business in danger. AN IMMERSIVE PUB MANAGEMENT EXPERIENCE With its deep management system, evolving gameplay, and realistic pub-building mechanics, The Pub Life Simulator  Prologue offers a truly satisfying adventure. Transform dust into charm and build the pub you’ve always dreamed of become the favorite spot in town! ADD IT TO YOUR WISHLIST NOW! There’s no limit to how big you can grow! Build the pub of your dreams, become the neighborhood’s favorite spot, and rise as a star in the world of bars. Don’t miss out on this realistic pub management simulation! Add The Pub Life Simulator Prologue to your wishlist now and be among the first to play!
row.short_description: Open your own pub with The Pub Life and keep your customers happy with refreshing drinks and great service. Enjoy this cozy and detailed simulation experience solo or with a friend. Level up, unlock higher quality beverages, and expand your pub to create the most popular spot in town!
row.notes: This game offers a virtual pub management experience and includes: - Gameplay mechanics involving the sale of alcohol. - Scenes that feature alcohol as part of the simulation elements, without promoting its consumption. The game is designed as an entertaining management simulation and does not intend to encourage real-life alcohol use. Players are encouraged to make responsible decisions as a pub owner.

row.name: Unknowz
row.detailed_description: Unknowz Dive into an explosive pirate world developed in Unreal Engine 5, where two completely opposite pirates, one alive, the other undead, must cooperate to escape an island overrun by hostile skeletons. This cooperative adventure game throws you into a thrilling experience blending puzzles, stealth, and controlled chaos. Team up, combine your strengths, and escape this bony trap… if you dare! Gameplay In this cooperative game, two players take control of Jack, an undead pirate obsessed with black powder, and Ed, a living pirate struggling with self-doubt. Explore an island filled with traps and enemies, solve duo-based puzzles, and overcome explosive situations where coordination and timing are key. Each character has unique mechanics, and only well-oiled teamwork will lead you to survival. Narration Experience a story full of twists and turns, where the clashing personalities of Jack and Ed shape both dialogue and gameplay choices. Between friendship, tension, and revelations, the narrative takes you on a breathless escape from a cursed island. Get ready for an immersive story full of humor, mystery… and black powder! Artistic Direction Unknowz features a stylized and expressive art direction, blending moody ambiances with bright bursts of well-placed explosions. Powered by Unreal Engine 5, the environments come to life in a cartoon style that emphasizes both absurdity and epicness. The island, packed with secrets and danger, is a character in its own right. Project Status Unknowz is a student project developed over the course of less than 9 months, fully designed and built in Unreal Engine 5.
row.short_description: Unknowz is a cooperative platformer where two pirates, one alive, the other undead, must combine their unique abilities to solve puzzles, avoid traps, and escape from a skeleton-infested island. Work together... or sink!

row.name: There Exists
row.detailed_description: There Exists is a VR narrative experience that brings to light the emotional and complex realities of first contact between English settlers and the Traditional Owners of the land in 1790s New South Wales, Australia. Told through the intertwined lives of an English indentured servant and the Dharug people whose land was being taken, the story reveals the quiet moments, brutal ruptures, and fragile connections that defined this early colonial period. Developed in collaboration with First Nations and UK-based artists, historians, and cultural consultants, There Exists draws from archival records, oral histories, and extensive research to reconstruct a past too often silenced. You are invited to witness not just historical facts, but the human experiences behind them — displacement, survival, resilience, and loss. Supported by the BFI Film Fund, StoryFutures Academy, and the South Australian Film Corporation, There Exists is a powerful retelling of a shared yet contested history, where memory and emotion guide us through the echoes of a world forever changed.
row.short_description: A narrative VR experience where you explore 1790s Australia through the eyes of an English servant and the Dharug people. Uncover hidden histories, navigate immersive environments, and witness a pivotal moment of first contact.

row.name: Santa Elena
row.detailed_description: Santa Elena  is a real-time turn-based RPG where you control Elena, the Ruined, in an relentless revolution against the oppressive Duke of Monte Branco. Each battle is a marathon against hundreds of enemies , so Elena must manage her resources and keep her allies healthy to match the relentless pace of war. Every feeling and every memory leaves data imprints floating unseen. Elena's implant lets her harvest this psychic static and weaponize it. Her Truth Made Manifest. Through the art of Somatism, she can trace arcane symbols, tap into the stream of past whispers lingering in the air, and manifest them physically in battle, in an original magic system that favors player creativity and mastery of dozens of possible incantations. Santa Elena is a story about the human element of a revolution. Meet the game's iconic characters as the scale of conflict reaches irredeemable proportions. What is Elena willing to sacrifice in the name of her cause?
row.short_description: The only path left is forward. Take the reins of Elena's revolution, conjure powerful incantations with the forgotten echoes of history, and deliver the final blow to the Duchy of Monte Branco in this short (2-3h) linear turn-based RPG with plenty of room for tactical creativity.
row.notes: Contains not graphical violence and themes of bodily autonomy

row.name: Blobun Mini
row.detailed_description: A New Adventure on Pico8! After the events of Blobun, Stephanie and her girlfriend decide to continue adventuring for fun! Take a small trip around Mythandra and solve many puzzles. Your goal is simple: touch every tile! However, it's not as simple as it sounds. Many obstacles get in your way, from floor zappers to deadly lava. You'll have to keep sharp to solve these puzzles! This is not simply a remake of Blobun on Pico8. This game features all new puzzles using familiar puzzle elements, enjoyable by both new players and existing fans! Puzzle Elements and States During your journey, you'll come across many different types of puzzle elements, from toggle blocks to cracked floors, conveyer belts, and more. You'll have to learn what each puzzle element does and plan accordingly. In addition, you'll find state change tokens in some puzzles, allowing you to change to the fire or ice state. These will change how you engage with the puzzle! Features Made a wrong move? You can undo your mistake! There's also no time limit, and you can try each puzzle as many times as you like. If a puzzle is too hard, you can skip it!  You only need to complete enough puzzles to progress. Optional timers are available if you wish to test how fast you can beat each puzzle. However, you don't have to! Options Show Timers: If you want to challenge yourself, you can turn timers on and see how fast you can beat each puzzle. This is completely optional! Slime Overlap: When disabled, you'll be prevented from overlapping your own trail. However, conveyer belts will still push you into it. Sprint By Default: When enabled, Stephanie will move fast, and holding the Sprint button will make her move slow instead. Music/Sound Effects: You can toggle these on and off. Lesbians Allowed: This game features a lesbian protagonist. If you want to remove lesbians from the game, you can turn this off.
row.short_description: You are a blob bunny. Your goal? Touch every tile! Enjoy 60 bite sized puzzles across 5 different worlds in this casual puzzle game.

row.name: Cube1 vs Cube2
row.detailed_description: Engage in an epic clash and dominate the cubic battleground! Cube1 vs Cube2 is a fast-paced local multiplayer action game where two (or up to four!) players face off in chaotic duels using a massive arsenal of weapons across wild, gimmick-filled arenas. Jump, dash, shoot, and outsmart your opponents in high-stakes battles where every move counts. Features: 21 maps in 9 different worlds, each one with its own gimmicks +30 weapons to master A skin store with +20 outfits to customize your cubes Local Multiplayer: Up to 2-4 players by connecting gamepads. Controls Are you ready to enter the arena and engage in challenging one-on-one battles? Join the fray and showcase your skills in this addictive cube game!
row.short_description: Engage in an epic clash and dominate the cubic battleground! Join the fray and showcase your skills in this addictive cube game!

row.name: Club del fierro
row.detailed_description: Limited Edition Run today in our 1/4 & 1/8 mile, set of southern America About the Game Welcome to Club del Fierro! Club del Fierro is a drag racing and simulation game inspired by Latin American car culture. Race on professional circuits, fully customize your car, and compete against other players online or solo to prove who’s the fastest. Main Features: Offline & Online Races: Compete in drag races against the AI or challenge other players online. Full Customization: Modify engines, suspensions, wheels, appearance, and more to create your ideal car. Wide Variety of Cars: Choose from over 70 classic and modern models, including iconic vehicles from the region. Events, Rankings, and Global Leaderboard: Take part in weekly events, climb the rankings, and compete to become one of the fastest in the world! Realistic Physics: Enjoy a realistic simulation of driving, acceleration, and car building. Time-based Categories: Participate and become the best in your category. Categories are based on your times in 201, 250, and 402 meter races. It's not just about being the fastest, but about being the most precise! Feel the passion for racing, show off your skills, and compete with players from around the world in Club del Fierro!
row.short_description: Argentine mile 1/4 career game. It contains rules based on category/time. Category drop, track invasion, overtaking, etc. If you like chopped or torn, this is your game.
row.reviews: “El mejor juego de picadas de argentina...” 4.0 – Playstore “El juego que siempre soñe!” 4.7 – Appstore

row.name: The DeadLine
row.detailed_description: “This is the last train. And you are its only passenger.” One day, the world became overrun by the undead. You boarded the final subway still in operation, bound for a single destination: City Hall , where your family might still be waiting. But this train isn’t just your escape—it’s a gauntlet. At every station, you’ll face ravenous hordes of zombies. Only by activating the fuse at each stop within the time limit can you move on. Fail… and a brutal fight for survival awaits. Game Overview The DeadLine is a first-person survival FPS set in a zombie apocalypse, where every station brings new tension. Face a relentless clock, grow stronger with roguelike upgrades, and immerse yourself in addictive, high-stakes gunplay. Key Features Distinctive Weapon System Choose from Normal , Epic , and Legendary firearms—each delivering a perfect blend of realism and fun. Race Against the Clock Complete your mission at each station and return to the train before time runs out. Unstoppable Zombie Hordes One second too late, and waves of undead from previous stations will overwhelm you.   Skill Chips & Upgrades Collect Skill Chips during combat to unlock powerful abilities and customize your build. Endless Mode Leaderboards Compete with other players in Endless Mode , climb the global rankings, and prove you’re the best. “May the odds always be in your favor.” The train departs. Begin your desperate fight for survival.
row.short_description: The last subway departs in a world overrun by zombies. At each station, gather materials, find better weapons, and fight off the undead. As you get closer to your family, the danger grows. Survive, upgrade, and make it to the final stop.

row.name: Patch me if you can
row.detailed_description: Patch me if you can is a unique puzzle adventure where you dive into a game world, freely manipulate objects, and embark on an epic quest. Find the Bugs Use Glitch Vision to uncover broken objects hidden throughout the world. Click on glowing pink anomalies to open their status window and manipulate them! Fix the World Your Way Equip light, rotation, scale, or control blocks in the status window to freely control each object. Shrink boulders, move the sun, or experiment with clever combinations to reshape the world to solve puzzles with your imagination. Rescue Your Daughter Your beloved daughter is trapped in a bug-riddled game world. As both her father and the creator of this world, you must outwit a cunning Lord and use your creativity to bring her back.
row.short_description: Patch me if you can is a puzzle adventure where you dive into a game world and manipulate objects however you want. Equip blocks to shrink boulders, move the sun, and thwart Lord's conspiracy. This broken world needs your 'patch'!

row.name: StacKit
row.detailed_description: Welcome to a turn-based, tactical 3D shooter where your mind is your greatest weapon. You are a lone survivor, fighting your way out of a high-security facility after stealing a powerful secret. Every machine in this automated fortress is hunting you down. Brute force won't save you—survival depends on your ability to outwit the AI, one strategic turn at a time. The key to your escape is the 'Stack' . Before each encounter, you'll fabricate bullet and load your ammunition. The fate lies not in what you fabricate, but in the precise order you load it in. This sequence is your battle plan. Will you start your turn with a Fire round to melt armor, follow with a Corrosion round to expose a weakness, and then finish with a Basic round? The battlefield is a puzzle, and your Stack is the key. This is a battle of wits, not reflexes. Analyze the battlefield, predict enemy actions, and execute the perfect sequence of shots from your Stack to neutralize robotic threats and control the fight. Your journey is a calculated cycle: Shop to build your arsenal, Plan your Stack for the upcoming fight, and Battle through turn-based encounters. Each cleared room brings you one step closer to freedom. Face a diverse army of robotic sentinels, from nimble drones to heavily armored security units. You must adapt your tactics and fine-tune your Stack to counter every new challenge the AI throws at you. Immerse yourself in a cold, post-apocalyptic world brought to life with 3D graphics. This is a pure, focused tactical experience—just you, your weapon, and a series of complex combat puzzles to solve. Can you devise the perfect strategy and dismantle the machine to win your freedom?
row.short_description: StacKit is a turn-based puzzle of pure strategy. Load your gun in a precise order before you fight—this is your 'Stack'. Once in combat, your firing sequence is locked. Use Fire to strip armor, then hit with Corrosion to weaken foes and boost all other damage.

row.name: Realm of Mystery
row.detailed_description: In the thrilling world of 'Realm of Mystery,' a vast medieval continent sprawls under the shadows of eternal war. Kingdoms clash and tribes battle across landscapes brimming with dense forests, towering mountains, and roaring rivers. This realm, alive with mythical beasts and bizarre creatures, beckons the brave to test their mettle. Players may don the mantle of a valiant knight or a seasoned soldier, diving into the heart of conflict, leading armies in grand campaigns, or carving out their own kingdom amidst the chaos. Alternatively, the life of an adventurer awaits those who prefer the thrill of discovery, offering endless opportunities to explore the continent's hidden corners, undertake perilous quests, and face formidable foes in combat. Magic courses through the veins of this world. Ancient wizards and cunning sorcerers wield arcane spells that can sway the tide of battle, mend deadly wounds, or even foretell the future. The air is thick with the power of old gods and spirits, whose ancient legacies can shape the destiny of the world itself. 'Realm of Mystery' is a portal to a medieval world saturated with warfare, adventure, and supernatural forces. Here, every path is open and glory awaits any who dare to take it. Setting and Atmosphere : The game is set on a vast medieval continent characterized by ongoing wars and conflicts among kingdoms and tribes. The environment includes dense forests, towering mountains, and roaring rivers, creating a dynamic and immersive world for players to explore. Gameplay Options : Players can choose different roles such as a knight, soldier, or adventurer. This choice affects their gameplay experience, whether they prefer engaging in large-scale battles, leading armies, or exploring and undertaking quests. Role of Magic : Magic plays a significant role in the game, with ancient wizards and sorcerers capable of casting powerful spells. This adds a layer of strategy and depth, as players can use magic to influence battles, heal, or gain insights into future events. Creatures and Mythical Elements : The world is populated with mythical beasts and bizarre creatures, offering challenges and opportunities for players to test their skills and courage. Narrative and Freedom : The game offers a narrative filled with warfare and supernatural forces, but also emphasizes player freedom, allowing individuals to carve their own path and seek glory in various ways.
row.short_description: Set forth on an epic journey of conquest!

row.name: Deckstination
row.detailed_description: Build Your Own Skill Deck Remove unnecessary skills and create powerful skill chains to control the flow of battle. Collect and combine skill cards to craft your perfect deck. Moment-to-Moment Decision-Making Leads the Battle The battle never stops. In the midst of randomly appearing cards every moment, choose the skill you need most right now. Resources are limited, and opportunities are fleeting. Strategic Synergy in Card Combinations Winning is not just about having the strongest cards. You must quickly judge and combine cards to create powerful chains. Your Decisions Are the Art of Battle Instant judgment, perfected decks. Your choices and your deck are the key to survival. Key Features Real-time card selection and tactical action Pressure of limited resources and spontaneous choices Strategy design based on synergy between cards
row.short_description: Deckstination is a real-time combat and deck-building hybrid. In this action roguelike, players use customized skill decks to overcome enemies in battles. Combine randomly drawn skills to survive intense encounters and take control of the battlefield with your own actions and strategy.

row.name: Lake of Darkness
row.detailed_description: Lake of Darkness is an atmospheric visual novel psychological thriller inspired by games such as Milk Inside a Bag of Milk, Omori, And the Don't Escape trilogy. As your small town is coming to grips with multiple mysterious disappearances you get a premonition in a dream that you are destined to die in three days. The game reacts to the choices you make.  Will you hide from your fate? Spend your last few days with loved ones?  Try to break the cycle? Or rediscover the secrets of your past? Developed in Renpy, this game is the first major project from a solo developer. In Lake of Darkness you follow a teenager as they try to understand the strange town they live in and defeat an inescapable ominous pursuer. Taking place over 3 days you have limited time to prepare for their arrival and to understand the mysteries surrounding these strange creatures. Features include: 10+ collectable items 25+ unique endings Soundtrack with 30 atmospheric songs Branching story with a dialogue script over 8000 lines long 3 Repeatable minigames Interactive 2D pixel art environments & many horrific fates to discover.
row.short_description: Your small town is slowly becoming corrupted by a mysterious evil, In a dream you get a premonition of your own death. How do you avoid an unknown fate? Spend your final moments wisely in this choice-based psychological horror visual novel game.
row.notes: This game features content and themes that many readers may find disturbing or otherwise offensive such as: abuse, addiction, anxiety, depression, grief, and suicide. This game also features graphic descriptions of violent scenes.

row.name: CARGOGO
row.detailed_description: The girls are about to embark on a road trip... Every time you press a key, your car gains momentum. Reach a destination, and you’ll unlock a new vehicle. Whether working, studying, or gaming... every keystroke helps the girls unlock new maps and continue their journey. Ready to ride? Let’s go!!! ———————————————————————————————————————————— Game Features Multiple characters to choose and unlock A variety of cars to collect Arrive at world-famous cities and collect city postcards No extra effort needed—just type and click as usual on your computer, and the car will drive automatically Car Drop Rates Bronze Chest: 87% Bronze, 8% Silver, 4.9999% Gold, 0.0001% Diamond Silver Chest: 2× higher chance for Silver or above compared to Bronze Gold Chest: 2× higher chance for Gold or above compared to Silver Diamond Chest: 2× higher chance for Diamond compared to Gold Other Features ✔ Relaxing gameplay ✔ A wide variety of cars ✔ Easy way to collect rare vehicles Game Mode: Press [F4] to hide the interface and enter game mode.
row.short_description: Each time you press a key, your vehicle gains movement power. Every destination reached unlocks a new car. Whether working, studying, or gaming... every keystroke you make will help the girls unlock new maps and continue their journey. Ready to ride? Let's go!!!

row.name: Clean Break
row.detailed_description: Clean Break is a short first-person narrative game about objects, memory, and the quiet violence of letting go. Explore a seemingly ordinary home. Break furniture that doesn’t belong. As the house begins to change, so does your understanding of what you’re really  breaking. A surreal 20 minute journey through grief, memory, and emotional cleanup.
row.short_description: Explore a quiet house. Destroy any furniture that seems... off. This is just a bit of decluttering. Probably.

row.name: Playing With The Big Boys
row.detailed_description: If you like it, consider supporting it on Kickstarter PLAYING WITH THE BIG BOYS is a 2D, point-and-click, narrative-driven adventure video game with a focus on atmosphere , character , and storytelling . Step into the worn-out shoes of Jack, caught in a world of bigger players , dirty deals , and personal demons . Explore hand-crafted environments, uncover layered storylines , and interact with a cast of eccentric characters. At the heart of Playing With The Big Boys lies the struggle for freedom, but freedom isn’t what you think. You’re not just trying to escape a place; you’re navigating what freedom really means in a world that never lets you forget you’re just a child . Every choice , every step deeper into the city’s shadows , shows how power shapes lives, how it’s given , taken , abused , or stolen . You’re navigating the complex, painful journey of claiming your own will in a world that tries to control it. And sometimes, the hardest part isn’t the dangers outside, but the fear inside. This is a story about power , survival , and what it really means to be free when every path feels like a trap . Core Gameplay Crafting: Scavenge and combine everyday objects to create tools and items that help you survive and navigate the harsh streets. Dialogue: Talk to characters to uncover clues, learn new information, and unlock quests. Every conversation helps you piece together the story and find your way forward. World Interaction: Use found items creatively to manipulate your environment like buckets to reach high places or triggering hidden mechanisms to open secret routes. Mini-Games: Face quick, tense challenges such as defending yourself against a street kid who’s trying to provoke a fight, test your reflexes and wits to come out on top. Narration: Hear from the older version of the kid you play as, reflecting back on his journey through the city. His voice adds emotional weight and perspective, reminding you that every choice shapes the person you’ll become. You’re just 12 years old , running away from a life full of chores , rules , and empty promises , chasing the freedom you’ve never known. No more homework , no more responsibilities , just the hope for something better . Your journey begins at the train station , where you scramble to find two halves of a torn ticket and some glue to piece them together, your fragile pass to anywhere but home . The midnight train carries you far away , delivering you to a dark , unforgiving city , a place where freedom means something else entirely. Here, survival is a game ruled by three ruthless figures : The King of Beggary calls himself a father to the lost, teaching his “children” the art of survival, one coin at a time. Madam Vile moves through velvet halls and velvet lies, her sweet-smelling remedies masking something far more bitter. Vladimir is a name whispered in every corner of the city. Some say he saves kids. Others say he owns them. No one really knows, and that’s exactly how he likes it. In this city, freedom isn’t given, it’s taken , fought for , and sometimes lost . Every step you take pulls you deeper into a world where the lines between hope and despair blur, and where the true cost of freedom is never clear. You’ll cross paths with a cast as rough and real as the streets themselves: runaway kids like you, cunning thieves , stray cats weaving through alleys, drunken souls lost in their haze, hardened criminals , hopeful dreamers , and many more. Each character has a story , a secret , and a role to play in your journey, some friends , some foes , all part of this living, breathing world .      If you enjoyed the demo , the art style , and the glimpse into a story that’s both heartfelt and thought-provoking , supporting Playing With The Big Boys helps bring the full vision to life , with richer features , improved visuals , and a deeper , more immersive experience . This game explores the illusion of freedom in a society that promises much but delivers little . It’s for anyone who’s ever dreamed of running away from responsibilities to see where life might take them, but told through the eyes of a child in 1902 . Playing With The Big Boys carries a powerful message at its core about survival , power , and what freedom truly means.
row.short_description: Survive the streets, outsmart the gangs, and uncover what freedom really means in this dark narrative adventure.

Forest Rites
row.detailed_description: You are Goya, a young raccoon determined to complete your village’s sacred rite of passage. To prove yourself, you must face — and defeat — nine fearsome opponents in a relentless gauntlet. Will you overcome the trials and earn the right to leave your village and explore the world beyond? Forest Rites is a card battler inspired by trick-taking games. It’s meant to be a compact, gameplay-driven experience with very light narrative elements. I made this between 2021 and 2024 in my spare time as a fun experiment around a rarely-seen mechanic in video games. Features: Short length (30 to 45 minutes per game) Roguelike progression Fight your opponents through a card system inspired by trick-taking games Face the forest's masters, each with their own fighting style and strategy Two modes available: beginner and normal In normal mode, your score is saved at the end of each game: try to beat your best score and climb the leaderboard!
row.short_description: Defeat the forest's masters in this exciting trick-taking card battler!

row.name: Hotel Hideaway: Avatar & Chat
row.detailed_description: TO PLAY HOTEL HIDEAWAY VIA STEAM WITH AN EXISTING ACCOUNT, YOU SHOULD CONNECT IT TO YOUR FACEBOOK ACCOUNT! Step into Hotel Hideaway – a vibrant 3D social world where you can create, connect, and be whoever you want to be! Express Your Style! Create and customize your 3D avatar with endless options. Choose from a huge variety of clothing, accessories, hairstyles, and tattoos – from casual streetwear to outrageous fantasy costumes. With new items released weekly, your look will always be fresh. Design Your Space! Design your dream room with furniture and décor that matches your vibe. Host epic parties for your friends, create a private retreat, or show off your interior design skills to the world. The choice is yours. Socialize & Explore! Meet new people from around the world, form tribes, and compete in groups for rewards. Explore the Hotel’s lively public spaces, uncover hidden secrets, and stand out in seasonal events and themed locations. Always Something New! Party at the beach, relax at the spa, or attend live concerts by real-world artists. From fashion to friendship, adventure is always waiting. So, what are you waiting for? Jump in and leave your mark on Hotel Hideaway today! For ages 17+
row.short_description: An immersive 3D social simulation MMO where you customize your avatar, build and decorate rooms, collect rare items, and join live community events in a nostalgic yet ever-evolving virtual world.
row.notes: Although Hotel Hideaway: Avatar Chat contains no graphic violence, gore, or explicit sexual content, it is rated 17+ and designed for an adult audience. All “conflict” is playful—think pillow fights or harmless pranks—with no combat system, blood, or injury depicted. Avatars may wear swimwear or lounge attire, but there is no nudity or sexual acts shown. Because it’s a live-service social MMO, user chat can sometimes feature strong language, suggestive banter, or mature role-play. Virtual venues often include decorative bar counters and pixel “drinks,” but there is no real substance-use mechanics or intoxication effects. We do not depict sexual assault, non-consensual acts, self-harm, or drug abuse in any storyline or event. To maintain a safe environment for our adult community, we employ AI-driven moderation alongside block/ignore/report tools—so you remain in control of your social space. Only for players aged 17 and up who are comfortable with open chat and user-generated content.

row.name: Chrono Port : Heroes of All Time
row.detailed_description: CHRONO PORT: HEROES OF ALL TIME Travel through time, unite legendary heroes, and save the world. Brief Overview: Chrono Port: Heroes of All Time is a strategic role-playing game (RPG) where players embark on a journey through time, recruiting legendary heroes from different eras to save the world from an ancient evil. Combining turn-based combat, exploration, and character progression, players use the powerful Chrono-Porter to unite a diverse team of heroes from across time and space. Game Genre: Turn-Based RPG, Hero Collection, Time-Travel Adventure Target Platforms: PC, Console, Mobile THE STORY A boy playing with his drone dreams of adventure. He hears a loud noise and runs to the window. Stepping outside, he witnesses a massive monster wreaking havoc on the city. He tries to fight, but an old Master stops him. The Master reveals a long-kept secret—the existence of the Chrono Port . He entrusts the boy with it and tasks him with summoning heroes from across time to save the world. HEROES AND VILLAINS Heroes: Unlock and recruit 60 legendary heroes from different time periods and mythologies. Each hero has unique abilities, attributes, and backstories, offering varied playstyles and strategies. Customize heroes via skill trees to shape their roles—Tank, Healer, or Mage. Equip them with powerful items and stat enhancers to increase their combat effectiveness. As heroes level up, allocate skill points to unlock or enhance abilities. Villains: Face 30 unique villains, including mythical beasts, warlords, sorcerers, and legendary monsters. Each villain presents tactical challenges requiring strategy and team synergy. Every world ends with a powerful boss fight featuring special abilities and environmental threats. BATTLE DYNAMICS Roles: Each role is color-coded: • Green – Healer • Red – Warrior • Blue – Mage Progression: Frequently used heroes earn XP and level up. Currencies & Items: Coins: Used to purchase consumable items. Gems: Unlock stat-enhancing items. Stat Enhancers: Boost hero stats like attack, defense, and health—crucial for tough encounters. Consumable Items: Provide temporary boosts or debuffs, often turning the tide of battle. Strategic Depth: Swap heroes mid-battle to counter threats or adapt to environments. Master buffs, debuffs, and stuns to control the flow of combat. CORE MECHANICS Exploration: Travel through 60 unique worlds using the Chrono-Porter. Each world features distinct environments, enemies, quests, puzzles, and hidden treasures. 3 vs 3 Turn-Based Combat: Battle in teams of three heroes. Speed determines turn order. Choose to attack, defend, or swap—every decision matters. Hero Customization & Progression: Heroes gain XP from missions and combat. Unlock abilities via skill trees and evolve your team’s strategy. Resource Management: Collect and manage coins and gems wisely. Use them to upgrade heroes, unlock items, and progress through increasingly difficult challenges.
row.short_description: Travel through time, recruit legendary heroes, and battle an ancient evil in this strategic turn-based RPG. Explore 60 unique worlds, unlock 60 heroes, and face off against powerful villains in 3v3 combat. Customize your team and shape the fate of all timelines.

row.name: Wastelanders
row.detailed_description: Uncover the Wasteland’s secrets… and find your mom? A catastrophic meteor strike brings civilization to the brink, covering the planet’s surface in an alien substance known as the Waste. A sole beacon of civilization, the city of New Haven stands alone amidst a desolate Wasteland, held afloat by harnessing the Waste’s extraterrestrial power and defended by an intrepid force of explorers and researchers – the NITES. But all’s not well in the desert, and in the wake of her mother’s disappearance, Jackie, a young NITES hopeful, is determined to follow in her footsteps and uncover what’s really out there in the Wasteland. Key Features Dual-Deck Synergy : Each weapon deck boasts a unique theme with a powerful identity-defining buff, like the Staff's Flow and the Pistol's Accuracy. Draft skill cards from two weapon decks at once to assemble the combat deck, harnessing their unique buffs to discover devastating synergies within the web of carefully designed tactical possibilities. Selecting the right cards allows you to chain together devastating combos, dish out damage, and prevent your enemies from retaliating during a Clash. Unique Turn-Based Clashes : Meet your opponent’s attacks head-on by countering their moves with your own! Gone are the days of standing idly by as you politely wait for the opponent's attacks before you make your own. Opponents go head-to-head on the battlefield with their attacks, forming  Clashes  where only the strongest move connects! Consider the order of your actions carefully to sequence buffs, blocks, and combos to ensure enemy attacks never stand a chance at landing. Offense is the best defense! Learn to exploit Clashes and the Waste creatures will never stand a chance against you. Fully hand-drawn pixel art : Wastelanders showcases a modern twist on the classic 8-bit pixel art. Immersive narrative : Experience the story of Jacqueline 'Jackie' Page and leave your mark in the pages of New Haven. Adventure into the Wasteland, defeat Waste creatures under overwhelming odds, and find the traces left behind by Jackie's Mom. The Wasteland hides its secrets deep in its alien landscape, but the NITES hide something even more horrifying within the walls of New Haven. Perhaps the two are more entwined than they let on.
row.short_description: Survival looks ugly. Wastelanders is a dystopian turn-based card battler where desperation corrupts souls deeper than the alien Waste. Build your deck to defend Humanity's last haven, but avert their eyes. Lest they see that the Waste has already taken your beauty.
row.notes: This game contains use of firearms. There is no graphic violence, gore, or depictions of death.

row.name: Flying Courier
row.detailed_description: Flying Courier is a simulation game about a day of experience in a courier airship. Player will complete the task of deliveries, enjoy the view from different landscapes, and help people from the world with their requests. We started with the ideation of 'sharing something important with someone' as the theme of 'generosity'. While the game gives the option to players, we do not want to grant actual item 'rewards' to players which breaks the core of generosity. Instead, we decided to build a vast world that players can explore more places around the world by 'being generous' and help the locals all around the world. Therefore, we decided to build a world with different lands where players can explore and enjoy the scenery through an airship. Since the quests are simple, we decided to make the timeline of the story happen in the Victorian era with a cartoon-ish art style. Enjoy driving the courier in this lovely world!
row.short_description: In Flying Courier, pilot an airship, deliver packages, and explore a charming Victorian world. Help others through generosity in this cozy simulation adventure.

row.name: Fantasy Legend. The Frozen Century
row.detailed_description: This game is a Japanese RPG-style adventure game. Could the disaster that began on the frozen island that had been sealed for a thousand years, destroyed the peace of the continents for several years, and swept across the entire world be stopped in advance? A thousand years later, people will sigh at this moment. They will say: If someone can do something at this moment, will nothing happen next? As the investigator appointed by the kingdom, can you and your companions successfully investigate the truth and prevent this Because of the unknown disaster, the friendship among relatives and friends, the country and the nation, for the sake of the master and the country, we must never give up! This game has a total of 3 endings, each with a different game time. It requires crucial choices and exploration to achieve. This game can be replayed, and other endings will not affect the experience. Moreover, the main storyline of this game contains a large number of murder mystery puzzle-solving elements. Players can collect clues and uncover the truth while freely exploring. This game has an automatic save function, so you can play it with peace of mind.
row.short_description: In this game, you will meet new companions on your journey and fight with them to explore the truth from a thousand years ago. The rich plot performance, vivid combat experience and various branch plots will allow you to deeply immerse yourself in that special world.

row.name: Kaelaverse: Pemascape

This blacksmith's forge was well known by many to be one of the best in the land!  One day, the blacksmith known as Kaela Kovalskia has suddenly gone missing!
