row.name: Interstellar Nomad
row.detailed_description: Venture into a calm, immersive journey across strange new worlds. This is not your typical high-octane action game. Instead, it's a unique, physics-driven experience designed for adult players who enjoy taking their time, exploring at their own pace, and getting lost in procedurally generated and handcrafted environments. Built by a solo developer from the ground up—including its custom engine—this game offers: Planetary Landing and Exploration : Land on planets, walk their surfaces, and feel the terrain through realistic, physics-based animation. Interactive Physics Systems : Enjoy dynamic cloth and soft-body physics and nuanced character interactions that bring life to the world in subtle ways. Atmospheric Storytelling : Meet memorable characters and uncover small stories that evoke the spirit of classic sci-fi, inspired by the more contemplative moments of Star Trek . Slow-Paced Gameplay : Relax, solve light puzzles, take in the view, and experience a world that doesn't rush you. A Personal Project : This is a labor of love. It's not built in Unreal or by a big studio—just one person driven by passion. Don’t expect cutting-edge graphics or AAA-level animation. This is a small, indie project with a focus on atmosphere, physics, and creativity—not visual spectacle. This game is free to play. If players enjoy it, there may be an extended add-on in the future. It's not for everyone—but if you’re looking for something different, something calm and thoughtful with a touch of sci-fi nostalgia, this might be exactly what you’ve been waiting for.
row.short_description: First person single player 3D Sci-Fi adventure in space

row.name: Before you get trapped in the black lilies.
row.detailed_description: The protagonist wakes up and finds himself trapped in a bird cage. He doesn't remember why he is here, why he was locked in the birdcage, or even who he is in the first place. Strangely enough, the key to unlock the birdcage has fallen at his feet. He opens the key and explores the terrifying and strange Western-style house, searching for himself and the way to escape from this Western-style house ..... ◆◆◆◆◆ Play time is About 30 minutes to 2 hours. row.short_description: A horror adventure game in which you control the main character, a young girl with amnesia, as she explores a strange and terrifying Western-style house. Help the girl regain her memory and escape from the Western-style house by solving riddles and disarming tricks that obstruct your escape.
row.notes: This work may contain content that is not suitable for all ages or may not be suitable for viewing in the workplace, including but not limited to: strong language, violence or gore, or psychological terror.

row.name: FlushFall
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Flushfall!  In this game, your goal is to battle the other 99 toilets on the map until you're the last toilet standing! Why Toilets? Why are you fighting? How did you get here? These are the questions that go unanswered the entire game. Fighting Mechanics 'How do all these toilets fight each other?' I hear you asking. Well, they use the only thing toilets are truly afraid of... Plungers. As the player, you click once to kill anything in front of you! That's right, everyone is one tap! You're never  safe! In a world of 100 toilets, where they're all fighting to be the last standing, you're never truly safe. Unless, of course, you become the winner. When you win, let's just say something magical happens. Customization? 'Customization?' I hear you ask? This game has plenty. You can customise your toilet using points you earn from playing the game! Don't you worry though, you can't buy these points using real Money, there's no in-app purchases! It's time to have fun and battle toilets in FlushFall!

row.name: TakaichiMornSeed
row.detailed_description: Meet your new desktop buddy! This cute, yet sassy, little creature turns your desktop into its playground. row.name: AEXXOS
row.detailed_description: SPARTAN GAMES - Fair Play Guarantee AEXXOS is 100% no pay-to-win. Any real-money purchases are purely cosmetic—account- locked ship skins and vanity items—so every spaceship, ammunition and upgrade must be earned through gameplay. Your skill and strategy, not your wallet, decide your fate in the Galaxy. What is AEXXOS? Strap into the captain’s chair and command your destiny in AEXXOS. From your starship’s bridge, you’ll chart hyperspace routes, accept daring missions, and engage in heart-pounding PvP battles. Dock at bustling space stations to barter resources, coordinate fleet maneuvers with fellow captains, or execute stealth raids on rival convoys. With over 25 ship variants and 25+ upgrade choices , you’ll fine-tune engines, shields, weapons, and specialized modules to match your tactics—whether you’re a lightning-fast scout or a siege-ready dreadnought. Every loadout decision and alliance you forge shapes a living galaxy where your reputation is the ultimate currency. Living Galaxy AEXXOS’s universe runs on a living, player-driven economy—every resource you use comes from looting, trading, or conquering. Planets vary in what they offer: some lower-tier worlds yield raw ore, ammunition, and basic salvage, while more perilous systems reward daring captains with rare, high-grade materials. Pillage derelict ships for spare parts, conquer rival outposts to claim their stockpiles, or establish trade routes between star systems. As supply and demand shift, savvy captains buy low and sell high, turning battlefield loot into galactic influence. Conquer the Galaxy Forge your own path to supremacy: operate as a lone wolf carving out a reputation through daring raids and solo bounties, or ally with fellow captains in player-led corporations to seize control of star sectors rich in resources. Coordinate blockades against rival factions, plan synchronized assaults on orbital defenses, and defend your trade routes with fleet-wide tactics. Whether you’re staking a claim on a distant mining colony planet or rallying an armada to besiege an enemy stronghold, teamwork and strategic planning will determine who rules the galaxy—and whose legend endures among the stars. Indie Passion Project Born from the vision of a solo, dedicated indie developer, AEXXOS is our love letter to the classic MMOs of yesteryear and the communities that brought them to life. We’ve kept each feature intuitive for quick jump-in-and-play fun, while rewarding those who dive deeper with meaningful progression and discovery. And we’re only just getting started—this release lays the foundation for a universe we plan to expand and refine for years to come. Proudly self-funded and self-published, AEXXOS launches free of corporate influence and without any crowdfunding campaign—just pure passion driving every update. As a true passion project, we pledge to keep the universe growing—expect regular free updates, seasonal events, and fresh content drops as we build AEXXOS together with our players.

row.name: The CodFather
row.detailed_description: 'That wasn't fish. It was a real 3D hack and slash from a madman with a Cod!' Welcome to the world of cod. This game is a 3D wave action game where you fight using Cod as a weapon. In Classic Mode, you can acquire card skills by eating the gems that drop when you kill enemies, and in Challenge Mode, you can automatically acquire card skills every 40 seconds. Level up your skills and survive longer! Good luck! [ ▣ Game Concept ▣ ] The game started with a very simple idea. The term 'ecological' originated from the fact that it was called by various names depending on the condition or drying method of the Cod. I found it interesting how Cod changes depending on its environment, and the idea came to me that it would be fun to give it different attributes and make it into a skill. In this way, a battle system that humorously interprets the characteristics of pollack was born, and the 3D action wave method was chosen as the genre that could best express it. [ ▣ Card System ▣ ] In the game, players can have up to five skills, and the skills vary depending on the turn they appear. Only active skills appear in the first 1-2 turns, and only passive skills appear in turns 3-5. From the 6th turn onwards, active, passive, and basic skills will appear mixed together. If you select a skill that you already have from the skills that appear this way, the level of that skill will increase. If you have all 5 skills, no new skills will appear and you will only be able to select to level up existing skills. Skills have different maximum levels depending on their type, and have different limits depending on the game mode. In Classic Mode, the maximum level of all skills is limited to 3. In Challenge Mode, the maximum level of active and passive skills, excluding basic skills, is expanded to 5. Basic skills are skills that are closely related to a character's basic stats. As the game progresses, various combinations and strategies become possible, and strategic choices depending on the turn become an important factor. [ ▣ Customizing ▣ ] You can customize your character with various costume items obtained through battle, allowing you to enjoy the battlefield in your own style. ★ Only Korean and English are supported in the game. ★

row.name: Don't Let Me Fade
row.detailed_description: Don't Let Me Fade: adventure, interractive narrative [created in 48 hours as part of  GG-jam 2025 ] A narrative exploration game about memory, identity, and the slow unraveling of time. Created during a 48-hour game jam, Don’t Let Me Fade invites players into a poetic and emotional journey through the mind of a man losing himself to Alzheimer’s. A World Without Time The jam's theme, 'A World Without Time,' is interpreted here as a metaphor for Alzheimer’s - a fading world where memories slip away, and the boundary between past and present becomes unclear. Time has no meaning when memory itself is dissolving. The Story You play as an elderly man wandering through surreal, dreamlike environments stitched together from fragments of his memories… or is it his present reality? As you explore, you’ll piece together the outline of a life once filled with love, family, joy - and inevitable loss. The man is searching for a teddy bear, convinced it’s his last remaining link to who he truly is. Gameplay & Mechanics Short narrative experience (~10–15 minutes) Interactive story fragments reveal themselves as you explore No combat or puzzles  - just presence, memory, and atmosphere Simple first-person movement through fading spaces Soundtrack An atmospheric, emotionally layered soundtrack by Aink aka. Anna Glaid guides you through the shifting tone of the journey - from warmth and clarity to uncertainty and silence. The tracks Forget-Me-Not and Why does the heart beat were composed and recorded entirely during the jam. A fragile farewell to memory, identity, and everything we hold dear. Will you remember what he cannot? Play now, and step into a fading world.
row.short_description: Don't Let Me Fade is an interactive adventure about memory, identity, and loss. Piece together fragments of a life - even if a simple teddy bear is the last symbol of connection to oneself in a world without time.

row.name: Hekaba
row.detailed_description: Hekaba is a puzzle/platformer game. Puzzle: Puzzles are at the heart of the game, based on an original pressure plate mechanic that is used to solve them all. Platformer: Exploration plays an essential role in solving the puzzles. To do so, you can move freely using elements of the environment that give you special abilities, such as double jumps or long leaps. Immersive environment: In the heart of the desert, an abandoned temple opens its doors to you. Its strange and captivating environments await your curiosity. Translated with (free version) Game features: - Run and jump. - Move from platform to platform. - Solve puzzles to advance in the game.
row.short_description: After a long journey through the scorching sands of the desert, you come across an ancient abandoned temple. To get out alive, there is only one option: unravel the mysteries it holds.

row.detailed_description: Crystal of Atlan is a magicpunk MMO action RPG that supports cross-platform play between PC and mobile. The game centers on high-speed combos and three-dimensional combat, delivering a combat experience that combines both tactile satisfaction and strategic depth. DYNAMIC AIR COMBO COMBAT! Master fast-paced 3D combat even in the air. Break free from traditional ground-based combat! Chain combos from ground to air, combined with perfected airborne dodging, knockback collisions, and environmental interactions. Experience smooth combat like never before as you fill up the screen with dazzling visual effects and ignite your warrior within with hard-hitting skills! THRILLING FAIR PVP SHOWDOWNS! Dominate in PVP battles based on skill and mastery! Multiplayer PvP gameplay that emphasizes technical mastery and fair duels. In 1v1 Ranked Matches or 3v3 Team Battles, all players compete on equal footing with identical stats. Victory depends on execution, combo timing, and team coordination—true champions speak through skill alone. DISTINCTIVE CLASSES AND SKILLS! Customize skills with 10+ classes available! Choose freely from 5 base classes and 11 class branch options! Each class possesses over 20 skills that can be mixed and matched to build different combo rotations and playstyles for different combat roles. Find your very own build and playstyle! CHALLENGING TEAM BATTLES! Experience dungeons with strategic teamwork. An adventure is never done alone. Form teams and challenge co-op dungeons at any time! Fight bosses with unique mechanics and triumph over them with teamwork and coordination between classes! Fight together and share the glory and loot with your team! Team work makes the dream work! UNIQUE MAGICPUNK WORLD! Immerse yourself in a magicpunk adventure. Immerse yourself in the floating islands of Atlan, where magic and technology intertwine. As a member of the Adventurer's Guild, you'll delve into ruins, battle Decayed monsters, forge alliances, and uncover the truth of forgone civilizations, leading the world back to order.
row.short_description: Crystal of Atlan is a Magicpunk MMO Action RPG where you can immerse yourself in a Magicpunk world. Build your skills, fight and uncover the secrets of this world with your allies! Time to embark on a wondrous journey of Magic and Machinery!

row.name: You And I
row.detailed_description: You and I is a comedic, abstract FMV that offers a choose your own adventure style narrative following Mark as he gets lost in the woods with his friend Ace. However, the more time the two spend together, the stranger the two become. Make decisions based on the fractured relationship between Mark and Ace to understand what is really happening. Navigating through the woods takes between 15 minutes and 1 hour , depending on how deeply you engage with the story and choices. The gameplay is designed for meaningful exploration, and is built around three core systems: Two-Choice Decision System: Allowing for simple branching narratives, and easy ways of back-tracking. Skippable Replays: Already seen a scene? You can skip them to keep the pace flowing without losing context. Plentiful 'Endings':   While there are multiple unique paths and route endings to discover, the game ultimately concludes with a single, pivotal decision that determines the final outcome and reflects the full journey you’ve taken. As the forest path unfolds and reality begins to lose meaning, where will you find yourself? How will you view Ace? How will you view Mark? Who are they together? If The Truth is Yours, Then The Truth is That Everything is ... Directed by Juan Ablan and Written by Juan Ablan and Kai Hugessen Acting performances by Ved Ballary (Mark) and Kai Hugessen (Ace) Edited by Juan Ablan and Ciara Murray … You And I
row.short_description: 'You And I” is an interactive film where you guide Mark, lost deep in the woods with his friend, Ace. However the more time the two spend together, the stranger the two become.
row.notes: Depictions of violence is only implied through audio cues or context. There are topics of Cannibalism, nothing graphic only implied via audio cues. There is implications of murder that isn't ever displayed, but is implied via audio cues and/or context. Depictions of suicidal behavior. These topics are discussed as one of the characters urges the player to kill them in two separate occasions. Depictions of sexual acts are only implied through comedic audio cues or context. There is no graphical display of sexual activity.

row.name: SoulFeast(灵魂盛宴)
row.detailed_description: SoulFeast(灵魂盛宴)一款3D版类pvz的策略塔防游戏，玩家通过召唤卡牌灵魂生物进行作战，抵御外来势力的攻势。游戏设计了100余种卡牌生物，包括但不限于资源生产型，近战型，远程型，辅助型，防御型，部分卡牌生物更拥有奇特技能。游戏设置了圣物增幅机制，共有数十种不同的圣物，玩家可自定义圣物搭配，游戏还设置了元素反应机制，让战斗更有趣味。游戏内置了完整的背包库存系统和商店系统，帮助玩家攻略关卡，解锁更强力的卡牌和圣物，迎接更强大的敌人。

row.name: Microwave Yourself
row.detailed_description: Stick your head in a microwave to receive messages from god. Microwave Yourself is a casual VR puzzle game. Find the correct combinations of items to put in the microwave (along with your head!) to unlock unique visual effects, music, and a message to advance your progress. You must find all three combinations in order to 'escape' What to expect: Silly jokes Trial and error Relatively short (30-120 minutes) Small, interactable environment Free yourself from torment. (Originally an academic project, this short VR experience is designed to take no longer than a couple of hours to complete. All music, art, and visual effects were made by a small team with love.) (We also advise that you do NOT actually stick your head in a microwave!)
row.short_description: Microwave Yourself is a casual VR puzzle game. Interact with items and combine them in a microwave (along with your head!) to unlock unique visual effects, music, and a message to advance your progress. Find all combinations to escape your torment...
row.notes: The primary mechanic of this game is microwaving your head. However, there is no actual harm done by doing this other than some visual effects.

row.name: Casey Noir and Carved Pumpkin's Latte
row.detailed_description: You've read the description. It's pretty self-explanatory. If you're in a mood for a short, about 2 hour long, visually-heavy mystery game that's just right for the autumn season, then why not give this a try? However, if the free Halloween candy doesn't convince you, then read onwards. Step into the shoes of Casey Noir, an immortal, shadowy detective, who was invited to a Halloween party at a gothic hotel by a familiar face. Unfortunately, the reunion is cut short when one of the guests is murdered, with the murderer being one of the guests still present.  Investigate the hotel and its surroundings, chat with suspects, collect evidence, and dig to the bottom of what's exactly going on this Halloween. The masks of the party-goers conceal, detract, and lie.
row.short_description: What's this? A Point and Click, 'Who Done It?', Murder Mystery Visual Novel, set in a Gothic Hotel on top of a lonely hill, during the Night of Halloween?
row.notes: Outside of the depiction of murder scenes, most of it is just characters talking about said murders with some implication of suicidal behavior (no depiction or case of suicide)

row.name: Box Bunny
row.detailed_description: A rabbit living in a peaceful forest learns about abnormalities occurring in the forest. Violent animals that were not seen around invaded the forest, and animal friends who lived together changed violently. The rabbit takes out the box generator it has kept as a heirloom and leaves to investigate the forest to solve the abnormalities that occur in the forest. BOX BUNNY is an action adventure log-like game that can be enjoyed lightly with short playtime. You can escape dungeon by growing up in a limited situation, breaking through the pressure of monsters and killing a brutal boss monster. Combat monsters using attack, defense, and jump boxes generated through the box generator, pick your options and grow up to defeat the boss monster
row.short_description: Box Bunny is a log-like game that uses the boxes that are created to battle enemies, grow, and escape dungeons. Combat monsters using attack, defense, and jump boxes generated through box generators, pick your options and grow up to defeat boss monsters.

row.name: Simulators, strategies and pigeons
row.detailed_description: Simulators, Strategies & Pigeons A free collection of six independent games that explore the “simulator” genre from the most unexpected angles. From a medieval carrier pigeon to an alternative Slavic realm, from flower breeding to stick collecting — Simulators, Strategies & Pigeons offers six unique gameplay experiences created by indie teams. Each game stands on its own and dives into a different aspect of simulation: humor, emotion, exploration, or strategy. 💌 Carrier Pigeon Simulator Experience like a brave bird in the Middle Ages! Deliver letters between warring villages, evade obstacles, collect golden eggs! Establish peace and prosperity on the island! Genre: Simulator / Action-Adventure Setting: Medieval era Mechanics: Time management, quests, flight navigation 📰 Unbelievable Times You're a tabloid editor who's made a career faking stories about the paranormal — until it turns out they’re all true. Reptiloids are real. And now… you work for them. Genre: Simulator / Strategy Setting: 1960s America, sci-fi Features: Satirical narrative, political absurdity, aliens 🍂 Stay Strong! A meditative game about routine and the inner experience of someone going through a difficult time. No preaching — just repeated days filled with small acts of effort and emotion. Genre: Atmospheric Simulator Setting: Real life Features: Metaphorical mini-games, emotional progression, growing cycles 🌸 BloomWake A cozy fantasy simulator about magical flower breeding. Manage your own shop, bring life back to an industrial gray city, and rediscover beauty through creativity and kindness. Genre: Flower breeding & shop management simulator Setting: Miyazaki-style fantasy world Features: Relaxing gameplay, collection, emotional storytelling 🌲 This is my stick You find the perfect stick. Name it. Post it on a fake Reddit feed. Get upvotes. Explore forests, collect sticks, and earn the respect of your fellow stick fans. Genre: Cozy exploration / Collection Setting: Procedurally generated natural biomes Features: Humor, attention to detail, relaxing pace 🏰 Kings and... A simulator of leadership without absolute power. You are a regional ruler in an alternative version of early medieval Rus. Your party is your only true tool — use it wisely. Genre: Strategy / Simulation Setting: Alternative early-medieval Rus Features: Limited resources, recon and raids, semi-autonomous world Additional info 🎮 Platform: Windows ⏱️ Playtime: 15+ minutes per game 🧩 Genres: Simulators, Strategy, Adventure, Exploration, Meditative 🆓 Price: Free 👥 Developed by: Independent teams GD GUILD with the support of SUITD 'RESP' community

row.name: Twilight Syndicate
row.detailed_description: Twilight Syndicate is an adventure game where players take on the role of a rookie Interpol detective tracking criminals across the globe. Armed with only a initial clue, players must investigate locations, follow trails, and piece together evidence to capture their targets. Along the way, they uncover the secrets of the Twilight Syndicate, a shadowy organization tied to legendary heists. Twilight Syndicate offers a campaign mode where players solve cases and uncover the truth about the Twilight Syndicate. The game begins with the player receiving a clue that leads them to a specific location. Players travel, talk to NPCs, and investigate for more leads. Each location presents challenges like finding hidden clues or solving puzzles. The game focuses on exploration, deduction, and decision-making. Every choice matters, keeping players engaged as they uncover the Twilight Syndicate's secrets and get closer to capturing the main antagonist initially know as 'The Gentleman'.
row.short_description: Uncover global crimes as an Interpol rookie in this thrilling detective adventure. Chase clues, and expose the Twilight Syndicate!

row.name: Tower of Ba*bel
row.detailed_description: 'Roll her, squeeze her, feed her buns.' t. incorrectlyrics Slap the network center button, enter a unique letter combination and convince your friends to roll this beauty up a tower. What is going on?  Nobody knows!! Let’s find out in this multiplayer jank fest! Features Roll-a-ball physics based multiplayer (or solo) gameplay. Uncomplicated online networking. Funny sounds. A ferocious fiend has with forensic foresight fearlessly found our mistresses fatal flaw, every nightfall she falls fast asleep. She awakens confunded! For where am I?  Frighteningly fresh this fanciful facility, with fragile falls in unforgiving forks.  Oh look! This guy is talking, I should pay attention. You roll a ball of water up a few levels, that's the game. Thank you.
row.short_description: Our mistress has been kidnapped by a masked menace. But fear not!! The buds are on the case in this slightly frustrating roll up a tower, with a berrific ending.

row.name: The Manor
row.detailed_description: Welcome to The Manor. In this RPG, you control a mage working for DEMONCORP. Now you must solve a case for a disgruntled customer... or die trying. features: Top-down hand drawn world. Brain teasing puzzles Engaging spell system brimming with personality. Soulful, character-rich story with an emphasis on humor. Created by one person. I thought I found a 7th dog, but it was actually just the 3rd dog. If you play this game, can you count the dogs for me...? I'm not good at it.
row.short_description: Another day in the office. Exorcising Demons!

row.name: Valiants: Arena
row.detailed_description: Discover Valiants: Arena! Welcome to the Arena, Tamer! Face off against other players with your team of 4 Valiants in strategic 2v2 battles. Swap your Valiants mid-battle and adapt your strategy in every match. Tactical and Dynamic Combat Switch your Valiants in battle and adjust your strategy as you go. But it might not be that easy with our Stage system. Winning? The arena might decide to make things harder for you. Losing? Maybe it’ll throw you a lifeline. Every turn is a plot twist. row.detailed_description: Stomach is a first-person cooking horror experience set on an abandoned cruise liner. Your only contact is a crackling phone that spits out increasingly disturbing orders. Deliver the plate somewhere in the ship’s shadowed corridors. Miss the deadline and learn why no one else keeps this job. 4. Advance deeper. row.name: Pantheon Poker
row.detailed_description: Pantheon Poker reinvents Texas Hold ’em as a mythology-themed digital card game . Play each hand with 4 random suits, each with unique mechanics that shift strategy and tactics every time. Use a powerful AI-powered luck mechanic to bend odds in your favor and outwit your opponents. Pantheon Poker blends the competitive depth of Texas Hold ’em with the creativity of deck-building games like Dominion . While the core poker rules remain—betting on who can make the best hand—the suits are where things change. Instead of the traditional four, each game draws from a pool of special suits, each inspired by a different mythological tradition. From Norse to Greek to Egyptian gods, every suit introduces new rules and card powers, creating a fresh tactical puzzle in every hand. At the heart of Pantheon Poker is a novel luck system powered by a custom AI model . Your cards and suit powers contribute to a luck stat , which subtly skews the probabilities in your favor. That means more favorable draws, stronger abilities, and clever ways to shift outcomes. Mastering this luck system is key to gaining the upper hand—and becoming a gambling god. Whether you're a seasoned grinder or just looking for a fun twist on poker night, Pantheon Poker is built for all skill levels . Play casually or compete at high-stakes tables with deep strategic depth. Sophisticated AI opponents offer a welcoming space for new players to learn—and a formidable challenge for veterans looking to train and refine their edge.

row.name: CODE::LUX
row.detailed_description: CODE::LUXは、マルチエンディング型ポストアプカリプス・短編アドベンチャーです。 ビジュアルノベルと、ローグライト風な行動選択型アドベンチャーを通して、無頼漢な男と無垢な少女二人の旅の結末を見届けましょう。 STORY 商業用核融合炉が実現した未来。 だが、世界大戦によってそのすべてが破壊・停止し、文明は崩壊した。 電力を失った社会は想像以上に脆く、今や人類は、各地に点在する小規模な再生可能エネルギー発電所と、生産不能なロストテクノロジー〈遺物〉を頼りに、かろうじて命をつないでいる。 そして誰ひとりとして、停止した核融合炉を再稼働させることができない。 なぜなら、融合反応を始動させるには、燃料を1億度以上に加熱・プラズマ化し、超高圧で封じ込める必要がある。その過程では、まさに“発電所を動かすための発電所”が必要なほどの莫大な初期エネルギーが求められる。 今の人類には、それを生み出す手段が存在しない。 ――ただひとり、「ミツハ」という少女を除いては。 CHARACTER ミツハ 文明の光を、この世界に取り戻そうとする謎多き少女。 見た目は幼いが、その頭脳は博士級。とくに工学分野においては、現代の専門家すら凌ぐ知識を持つ。 彼女は、旧国家に存在したすべての官営システムに対する管理者権限を有しており、秘密裏に存在していた、国際条約で禁じられた“最後の原子炉”を再起動させることで、失われた文明を再び動かそうとしている。 カイ 廃墟を巡り、遺物を集めて生きるスカベンジャー。 ある都市でミツハと出会い、彼女の力に価値を見出す。 その高尚な目的にはさほど興味を示さないものの、「遺物を得る手段」として彼女に協力することを選ぶ。 過去を語らず、現実的で冷徹――だが、どこか人間らしさも垣間見える男。 どうやら、本人には忘れたい過去があるようだが……？
row.short_description: 泥沼化した世界大戦によって主要な電力インフラが失われ、文明が崩壊した未来。 遺物を求めて廃墟を渡るスカベンジャーのカイは、旧国家システムを掌握する謎の少女ミツハと出会う。 彼女の願いは、ただひとつ――かつて世界を支えた核融合炉を再び動かすこと。

row.name: ONLY HARD
row.detailed_description: Only Hard is an intense and unforgiving platformer where every second counts. You play as a character determined to climb a mountain of obstacles, but every mistake costs you dearly. The goal is simple: reach the top, but the path is filled with pitfalls, traps, and challenges that leave no room for error. Each platform is a test of precision and timing. You’ll need to master complex jumps, avoid moving hazards, and navigate a variety of environmental elements that put your reflexes to the test. As you ascend, the terrain becomes increasingly difficult, and every fall sends you back to square one. The environments are varied and breathtaking: from steep mountains to ruined urban landscapes, each level offers a unique atmosphere that enhances immersion. The difficulty is ever-present, but it’s also what makes every bit of progress even more rewarding. The controls are simple, but each movement must be perfect to succeed. Solo players will quickly learn to master the game’s subtleties: jumping at the right time, avoiding traps, and knowing when to slow down or speed up. The game is designed to be brutal, but it’s precisely this challenge that makes victory so sweet. Only Hard is not a game for the faint of heart. It will push you to your limits, test your patience, but with every attempt, you’ll get closer to the ultimate reward: reaching the top and savoring the sweet taste of success.
row.short_description: Only Hard is an intense platformer where every mistake costs you. Climb a mountain full of traps and obstacles, mastering timing and precision. The higher you climb, the tougher it gets. A brutal challenge, but reaching the top and tasting victory is incredibly rewarding.

row.name: REDSHIFT
row.detailed_description: About This Game Redshift is a short solo developed psychological narrative horror game where you close your eyes to reveal a hidden layer of reality, the REDSHIFT. You play as Samuel Chase , a field technician sent by Northline Communications to restore power to a long‑abandoned military relay tower deep in the hills. The job feels routine, but is quickly revealed to be something much more. By activating the tower and starting the REDSHIFT, you reveal things that were never meant to be seen. Key Features Dual‑Reality Exploration Open your eyes to see the familiar world, or close them to uncover see into the REDSHIFT: hidden objects, shifting images, strange messages, and something else that's following you. A Focused Single‑Sitting Experience Designed to be completed in 10 to 20 minutes , REDSHIFT delivers a tight, atmospheric story that can be explored in one play session. Immersive Storytelling Uncover the past through environmental details, radio transmissions, and tense dialogue with your dispatcher as the tower grows stranger. A Living Soundscape Dynamic audio, subtle interference, and noise create tension and signal danger long before you see it. Multiple Endings Make your choices. REDSHIFT has two distinct endings, and it will be up to you what decision you make. Will you run, or will you face Tower 7?
row.short_description: A short solo developed psychological narrative horror game where you close your eyes to reveal a hidden layer of reality, the REDSHIFT. Uncover the secrets of the facility, Tower 7, and survive what hunts you within the REDSHIFT.
row.notes: Redshift is a psychological horror story experience intended for mature audiences. The game includes the following content: * Intense atmospheric horror and sustained tension. * Depictions of death, disturbing imagery, and implied violence. * Themes of isolation, paranoia, and mental deterioration. * References to a past casualty event. * Brief, abstract visual sequences that may be unsettling or surreal. Due to the game's heavy psychological themes and unnerving tone, it may not be suitable for players sensitive to horror.

row.name: Mazzy
row.detailed_description: Mazzy is a pixel-style casual puzzle game built around a simple but interesting idea: rotate and reshape the world. In this game, you play as a stickman navigating strange mazes. Your goal is quite simple—reach the goal. However, in this world, the path is not always straightforward. You will be blocked when you try to find the correct path. By switching to Edit Mode, you can rotate the entire sections, shifting platforms, unlocking new perspectives, and revealing the new paths that weren’t noticed before! Doors may block your way — or become part of the solution. You'll need to rotate with purpose, think spatially, and find clever ways to move forward. Mazzy offers a relaxing and engaging experience. Rotate the level. Collect the items. Reach the goal. It’s that simple — and that fun.
row.short_description: Mazzy is a pixel-style casual puzzle game built around the core concept of rotating the level. Rotate the level, collect the items, and reshape the maze to reach the goal. Simple and fun.

row.detailed_description: A ride home turns into a nightmare you never asked for. It was just another night. Just another road through the forest. You wake up trapped in a strange place, no idea where you are or how you got there. What follows is a desperate escape, eerie encounters, and choices that can save lives… or leave them behind. Stealth Survival : Stay low, stay quiet, and avoid those watching from the dark. Choices That Matter : Help others… or focus on escaping. Every decision counts.

row.name: Neo - The Rainbow Sorcerer
row.detailed_description: # Game Overview Title Neo - The Rainbow Sorcerer Game Theme/Story Neo is the last hope of Manatopia. Entropy has enslaved the minds of every elemental and sorcerer in manatopia except Neo. Neo fights against the elementals and Entropy himself to protect Manatopia. Perspective Top-down 2D, stylized grid-based layout Player Actions 1. Use WASD keys to move 2. Click on the screen to emit a mana cloud that destroyes enemies if their color are the same. 3. Change color with their mouse wheel. 4. Collect Elixir (buff) and Primordial Mana (treasure) and avoid enemies and their projectiles Enemy Behavior + Moves toward the bottom of the screen and depletes Neo's health if successfully reaching the bottom of the map + Shoots projectiles towards Neo to kill him. Gameplay Loop + Enemies spawn and move toward the bottom of the screen and shoots projectiles to kill Neo. + Neo's movement and attack via particle cloud + Random Elixir and Primordial Mana spawns which fills Neo's ultimate gauge or increases the score by 1000 respectively + Continue until death Level Progression Level ends: This game has only one level, like flappy bird. The player plays until losing 3 lives. Game Structure + This game invites users to experience a unique plane-shooter genre gameplay where the goal is not to shoot down the enemies but to damage them by selecting a color that matches their appearance. + While there is currently one level, the structure of the game leaves more levels to be easily added. Future Goals + Make infinite level generation using generative AI and implement bosses + Implement tutorial # Buff and Treasure System + Elixir (buff): Buffs increase Neo's ultimate gauge by 1 upon collision. When Neo eats 7 Elixirs, he can activate Rainbow God (ultimate) which gives him invincibility and the ability to damage enemies regardless of the current chosen color for 7 seconds. The mana cloud emitted during Rainbow God is also rainbow, instead of being one color. + Primordial Mana (treasure): Treasures increase the gameplay score by 1000 upon collision with Neo. # Game Assets Inventory Type Name Description Collision/Movement Player Neo A handsome white haired sorcerer who has infinite mana and use all types of mana. The following qualities are implemented as no cooldown for attacks and the player's ability to select a color using their mouse scroll. Enemy0 Cinder Imp A red mischievous fire sprite that occasionally fires a circle of slow flame bullets. Enemy1 Crystal Automaton A cyan floating arcane construct, fires ice laser at Neo occasionally Enemy2 Storm Whispling A yellow fast-moving wisp of lightning that erratically dashes and releases forked bolt barrages. Enemy3 Entropic Wraith A purple wraith that is a fragment of Entropy. Spawns black holes near Neo's radius that sucks him in and depletes one life upon collision. Treasure Primordial Mana Increases score by 1000 points. Auto-collected on collision. Extra Features + Color Picker Invisible hue bar that allows players to choose a color with their mouse scroll. + Made normally very laggy javafx animation very smooth by using an input poller. Please ignore the issue: 'Notice: This product is not compatible with macOS 10.15 Catalina or above. Click here for more information.' + The game works perfectly fine on macOS 10.15+ machines

row.name: NIGHTRAVEL
row.detailed_description: 『NIGHTRAVEL -ナイトラベル』は、形骸化したネオン街で展開される軽快なアクションと幅広いビルドの組み合わせが楽しめるマルチビルド2Dアクションゲームです。 ゲーム攻略のためには、キャラクターの特徴にあった立ち回りやビルド、そして連携の取れた協力プレイが求められます。ランダムに提供されるアイテムから自分だけのビルドを完成させ、フィールドを攻略していきましょう。 電脳管理への反旗を翻せ 深い闇と数多の光と共に沈んだ電子街《凍京》。 かつて《東京》と呼ばれ、文明発展と共に歴史を刻み続けてきた都市は AI管理システム《靜》の暴走によって、突如終焉を迎えた。 あなたは奪われた古郷を取り戻すために、電子街をハッキングしなければなりません。街に溢れる歩哨を掃討し、あなただけの戦闘スタイルでネオン街を駆け巡りましょう。 街からほころ出たデータの結晶「レリック」 崩壊した街、ワールドハック、設置された端末に隠された秘密。 突出した強化要素のついたアイテム「レリック」により、少女たちの戦闘に奥深さを追求します。 戦略と選択、そして組み合わせ あなたは 特異体質「構想欠陥 -バグ-」を持つ 時空改変者 -ハッカー- となり、街に蔓延る電子兵を蹂躙しなければなりません。 ハッカーたちはレベルアップする度にランダムな強化要素、または他の不思議なアイテムがピックアップされ、戦略的な選択を行います。あなた独自の新しい戦闘スタイルで圧倒しましょう。
row.short_description: 「NIGHTRAVEL」は、荒廃した電子街が舞台のマルチビルド2Dアクションゲームです。電脳支配された故郷を救うため「ハッカー」となり、反撃の狼煙を上げよう。 荒廃した空虚な街を駆け抜け、有象無象の敵対者たちを蹂躙しよう。一人でも友達と一緒でもプレイ可能。 戦利品を組み合わせて能力増強、各キャラクターを使いこなし、電脳システムに支配された街を取り戻そう。

row.name: Wish Upon a Cat
row.detailed_description: 'If I knew things were going to end up like this, I would've just apologized in the first place…' It's your best friend's birthday—but after a recent fight with her, you're not exactly on speaking terms. Before you even have a chance to wallow in regret, though, a burst of light erupts from your computer screen and sucks you into an alternate dimension—where a rather snarky mouse gives you the rundown. A rogue cat with a bad attitude has been leaping between realities and causing all sorts of dimensional mayhem—and if something isn't done to stop it, it might very well cause another big bang. And you DEFINITELY don't want that. With no other options available, you set off in pursuit of the feisty feline—not just to restore balance to the dimensions, but because it's the only way you'll ever make it back home. In this short-but-sweet adventure, you'll journey through the many worlds of Odencat games like Bear's Restaurant and Meg's Monster, meeting dozens of familiar friends along the way on your search for the runaway cat. Why did it throw the dimensions out of whack? What is it this little kitty-cat truly desires? And when all is said and done—what will YOU wish for?
row.short_description: Embark on a delightful little romp through the worlds of various Odencat games to track down a dimension-diving cat in this short, heartwarming adventure.

row.name: Ball Tag
row.detailed_description: Ball Tag is a fast-paced first-person multiplayer game you can play with friends. Ever want to throw a ball at your friend’s head? Now you can! One player is randomly chosen to start as IT , and their timer begins. If you're IT for 45 seconds total , you lose. Pick up the ball, aim, and throw it at another player. If you hit somebody else, they become IT  and your timer freezes. The match ends as soon as any player reaches 45 seconds of being IT.
row.short_description: Ball Tag is tag.... with a ball. This first-person multiplayer game challenges you to avoid being IT for a total of 45 seconds. Pick up the ball, throw it at another player to make them IT, and keep your timer from hitting the time limit.

row.name: Mate in Eleven
row.detailed_description: Mate in Eleven (#M11)  is Yet Another entry in the auto-battler format. M11 offers a unique twist of engine-based ' Perfect Combat ' to the auto-battler, which takes combat RNG out of the equation. Your positioning and your read on your opponent and their strategy is all that matters. With reduced shop RNG as well, this game captures the 'perfect knowledge' aspect of chess in the auto-battler format, while also allowing for players to think tactically. This allows for the perfect competitive auto-battler, where your micro-adjustments, positioning, and economical decisions decide exactly where you will place every game. Features Ranked matchmaking Custom lobbies (up to 8 players) Bots for custom lobbies Combat with engine lines for every position Custom ELO system to measure yourself against other tacticians
row.short_description: Auto-chess. Position your units, and the engine plays for you. Last player standing wins.

row.name: TunTunWorld
row.detailed_description: Welcome to TunTunWorld! This is a 3D action game like nothing you've ever seen before. You'll control a mysterious creature called TunTun as you progress through the game. At its core, it’s a simple third-person 3D action game. TunTun’s main ability is to poke things. He goes around poking objects around him! By poking, various reactions are triggered in the environment. Using these reactions, you’ll find your way forward. Other actions include jumping and grabbing objects. With 'Jump,' TunTun climbs to reach new areas and explore the world. With 'Grab,' you can carry key items and activate unique mechanisms. By using these abilities, you’ll gradually explore the map and solve its mysteries. If you solve all the puzzles, you’ll clear the game. So get poking and move forward into the unknown!
row.short_description: TunTunWorld is a 3D action game with a third-person perspective. Players control a character to explore the map, using three main actions: poke, grab, and jump. By investigating various areas, they can uncover and solve mysteries. The ultimate goal is to solve every puzzle and clear the game.

row.name: iRobot Factory
row.detailed_description: Can your robot solve every level? Immerse yourself in the exciting world of robotics and programming in the iRobot Factory! You can create your own robot and teach it to solve tasks - simply by connecting logic blocks together. Your robot will be completely on its own as it tackles the levels. In order for it to succeed, you have to prepare it! Build your own robot! Choose from a variety of building blocks and assemble your robot! Customise it to do what it needs to do in the level! Wheels allow it to move. Sensors allow it to perceive its surroundings. Gripper arms allow it to pick up objects and carry them with it.   Programme its abilities! Link logic blocks to teach your robot what to do! Programme how it reacts to the world around it so that it reaches the level's goal! Send a signal to the wheels to make them turn. Read the signal from a sensor to extend a gripper arm at the right moment. Link several signals so that your robot can swerve out of the way when it rolls towards a wall. You can programme this and much more for your robot!   There are lots of levels to solve Solve tricky tasks in increasingly challenging levels - from small obstacles to big puzzles where you have to combine all your knowledge! Start by building a robot with working wheels and finish by creating complex machines that master several different tasks.
row.short_description: Solve logic puzzles and obstacle courses in this robot simulation game! Immerse yourself in the exciting world of robotics and programming! Create your own robot, connect logic blocks and teach it to solve challenging tasks!
